data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
   

  

**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  

**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration**
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities**
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills And Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
   

  

* 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
   

  

* Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Entry\-Level Work Type: Contract Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.trivandi.com Job Function: Human Resources (HR) Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Professional Services

The TALENTMATE Portal idea is to fill and help professionals doing one of them by bringing together the requisites under One Roof. We do NOT endorse any requests for money payments and strictly advice against sharing personal or bank related information. We also recommend you visit Security Advice for more information. If you suspect any fraud or malpractice, email us at abuse@talentmate.com.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelors degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role with direct reports.
* Experience in both fiber optic network design/deployment (OSP) and data center infrastructure (ISP).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of multi\-disciplinary experience in network, fiber, electrical, and mechanical (cooling) systems.
* Experience working with global carriers and stakeholders in the EMEA and APAC telecommunications and data center markets.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to navigate through ambiguity and build consensus among high\-level executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record in New Product Initiatives (NPI), specifically in defining standards for deployable infrastructure solutions.


**About The Job**
 Googles projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. Youre equally at home explaining your teams analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering\-specific programs and teams.
   

  

 The Fiber Infrastructure Engineering and Delivery team is a unified organization within Google Global Infrastructure, integrating the expertise of capacity infrastructure engineering, network infrastructure engineering, and fiber and capacity delivery. Our mission is to deliver the resilient long\-haul and metro fiber assets and data center network space that power Googles global growth and AI leadership. We operate at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and global scale, ensuring Google’s network infrastructure is the most reliable and efficient on the planet.
   

  

 This role requires approximately 25% travel, mostly to Google’s data centers around the globe.
   

  

 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Googles product portfolio possible. Were proud to be our engineers engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Orchestrate program strategy across East EU and MENA to drive consistency and economies of scale. Be able to strengthen alignment between technical requirements and business objectives by providing advanced insights facilitating executive decision\-making.
* Define requirements for the Google Global Network, designing data center infrastructure (space, power, cooling) and define new product deployment globally.
* Manage complex relationships globally. Influence and collaborate with design engineering firms, carriers, internal engineering teams, and senior executives to solve large\-scale network growth challenges.
* Establish systems to identify and implement innovative solutions that optimize project delivery. Manage risks and drive improvements in lead\-time, predictability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Lead a global team of technical program managers. Foster growth mindset and culture of learning, ensuring the teams skills are transferable across technical domains.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Googles EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Manager - Projects Management
data.raw_snippet:
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To oversee the Procurement \& Technology portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and compliance with governance standards, while monitoring initiative progress, validating business cases, and ensuring proper documentation and budget approvals.
   

  

**K
data.jd_text:
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To oversee the Procurement \& Technology portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and compliance with governance standards, while monitoring initiative progress, validating business cases, and ensuring proper documentation and budget approvals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provides strategic oversight and direction for the entire portfolio, ensuring alignment with departmental and flydubai’s objectives.
* Leads the portfolio review process, ensuring timely and accurate reporting on key metrics such as budget, timelines, risks, and outcomes, while providing updates on portfolio status, performance, key milestones, potential roadblocks, and necessary corrective actions.
* Verifies and approves all relevant documents and ensure budget approvals are completed before submitting for the final sign\-off.
* Acts as a liaison between the Chief and departments under their supervision, ensuring smooth communication and timely updates on critical updates.
* Collaborates with other departments to identify interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive synergy across the flydubai portfolio.
* Validates all business cases and feasibility studies in coordination with department heads to ensure sound decision\-making.
* Tracks and manages the overall budget within the portfolio, ensuring compliance with corporate financial governance and budgetary controls, while ensuring efficiency and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Supports decision\-making by providing data\-driven analysis and recommendations on key initiatives.
* Manages escalations from department heads and other key stakeholders to ensure swift resolution of issues.
* Coordinates governance activities between the portfolio and the corporate Project Management Office, ensuring alignment on processes and reporting.
* Leads cross\-functional collaboration to ensure alignment on key initiatives across flydubai.
* Documents and administers corporate claims, ensuring proper record\-keeping and communication with relevant departments.
* Coordinates and updates project statuses to the flydubai corporate office and explores new technologies and efficiency improvements, implementing projects within Technology and Supply chain
* Develops and implements measures and metrics tailored to support technology and supply chain improvement projects, analyzing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify key trends and makes recommendations for operational improvements.
* Liaises with external stakeholders during the investigation and implementation phases of business initiatives, while monitoring the progress and the efficiency improvement projects and provides updates to senior management.
* Identifies potential risks to the CTSC and develops strategies to mitigate these risks and ensures compliance with industry regulations and standards in all business improvement initiatives, ensuring all project initiatives align with flydubai's strategic objectives and corporate goals.


**Qualifications**
* Master's Degree (2\+ years)
* Aviation Business Management Specialization.
* Fluent in English
* Demonstrable experience in effectively managing projects, with a proven ability to plan, execute, and achieve desired outcomes within specified timelines. Experience in aviation within IT.
* 7 \- 9 years
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification


**COMPETENCIES**
* Customer Focus
* Team work
* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability \& Commitment to achieve
* Resilience and Flexibility (Can do attitude)


**Isr Requirements**
 Reads and complies with the ISR policies of the Company and diligently reports any weakness or incidents to the respective Line Manager or the Information Security team. Completes all required ISR awareness sessions and follows associated guidelines in the day\-to\-day business operations.

**Distributor Excellence**
* Lead the Distributor Excellence framework across EMEA markets.
* Define performance KPIs, governance models, and execution standards for distributor‑led channels.

* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and leading transformation


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Senior commercial, execution, or excellence leadership experience
* Proven EMEA or similarly complex regional exposure
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent experience preferred

 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.

* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.

* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.

* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within the GCC region, particularly the UAE.
* Exposure to real estate development, infrastructure, or large capital project portfolios.
* Knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or equivalent project lifecycle management platforms.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or Prosci Change Management.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 This opportunity is ideal for a transformation leader who has successfully led enterprise\-wide change programmes and thrives in complex, fast\-paced environments. We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution, can influence senior stakeholders, and has a passion for driving sustainable organisational transformation and value creation.

**Role Description:** 




 This is a senior, group\-level role based in Dubai, reporting directly to the CEO. The Head of Operations \- Group provides operational leadership, governance and standardisation across Byrne's regional operations in the GCC.
 



 You'll drive fleet availability and utilisation, workshop and maintenance performance, logistics effectiveness, CAPEX planning and HSE compliance balancing local operational agility with Group\-wide consistency. Working closely with General Managers, Operations Managers, the Group Asset Manager, Procurement, HSE and Finance, you'll establish and monitor Group\-wide operational KPIs, scale operations efficiently and maximise fleet ROI across all territories.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical or related), or an equivalent technical foundation gained through experience
* 10\+ years in equipment rental, power generation, industrial services, logistics or construction equipment, including several years in a senior multi\-site or regional operations leadership role
* Multi\-country GCC experience (strongly preferred)
* Proven leadership of multi\-disciplinary, multi\-site teams (ideally across multiple countries) spanning operations, fleet, workshop/service, yard, transport and logistics
* Demonstrable track record of scaling operations while maintaining control, reliability and service standards
* Strong workshop, fleet, transport and operational cost\-control background
* Hands\-on experience with ERP / rental systems and asset utilisation reporting
* Strategic mindset with the ability to standardise and scale operations across regions



  





**Ideal Background:** 




 You're a hands\-on yet strategic operations leader with a solid engineering or technical foundation, who understands equipment and fleet inside out. You've progressed through operational roles in equipment rental, power or industrial services, built systems that let a business grow without losing control, and led teams across multiple disciplines and ideally multiple countries. You combine commercial awareness with operational rigour, lead from the front on safety and standards, and know how to turn performance data into action.
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 Byrne Equipment Rental LLC, part of the Byrne Group, has been a leader in the Middle East’s equipment rental industry for over three decades. Headquartered in Dubai, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain, boasting a fleet of 16,000\+ assets including modular buildings, power solutions, climate control, and hybrid solar systems. Recognized as one of the Top 100 Global Equipment Rental Companies (IRN100\), Byrne is dedicated to delivering reliable, innovative, and sustainable turnkey rental and infrastructure solutions. The company is committed to regional growth, digital transformation, and green energy investments.

data.jd_text:
***Lead the next chapter of a 30\-year Middle East AV/Pro Audio distribution business. Full P\&L, UAE\-based, peer to the CEO. AED 25\-40K total comp potential.***

  





  





**Business Head – Distribution \& Digital Commerce** 




**Techniline Electronics Group** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (on\-site) — 1 minute from Deira City Centre Metro Station, Red Line.
 



**Reports to:** 
 CEO
 



**Role Type:** 
 Senior Commercial Leadership \| Full P\&L Ownership
 



**Team Size:** 
 Multi\-channel commercial team across UAE and export
 



  




 About Techniline
 
 For over 30 years, Techniline Electronics has been the Middle East's trusted distributor of professional audio equipment, public address systems, and musical instruments. From our Dubai headquarters, we serve a network of resellers, system integrators, retailers, event companies, and end users across the UAE, Africa, GCC, and South Asia — built on transparency, reliability, and long\-term partnership.
 



 We operate at the intersection of distribution, retail, and digital commerce — including our flagship retail brands MusicMajlis and Soundline Main, alongside our principal distribution business and our growing e\-commerce platform. We are a hands\-on, owner\-led business of 40\+ people, running on the Scaling Up operating system: daily huddles, weekly KPIs, quarterly priorities, and A\-player standards.
 



  




 The Opportunity
 
 We are hiring a Business Head – Distribution \& Digital Commerce to own and lead the next chapter of growth for our core distribution business.
 



 This is the most senior commercial role in the company outside the CEO, with full P\&L ownership across all distribution channels — UAE trade and wholesale, key accounts, retail outlets, digital commerce, and export markets spanning roughly 30 countries.
 



 You will report directly to the CEO. You will operate as the commercial counterpart to the technical and projects function. You will own the team, the channel strategy, the pricing discipline, and the growth trajectory of a business with three decades of brand equity behind it and significant white space ahead of it.
 



  




 What You Will OwnFull Commercial P\&L
 
 Revenue, margin, cost\-to\-serve, and working capital discipline across the entire distribution business.
 


 Channel Leadership
 
 UAE channels (resellers, key accounts, SI/MEP/FM/contractors, retailers, event companies, end users, e\-commerce) and export markets across Africa, GCC, Middle East, South Asia, and beyond.
 


 Top Account Relationships
 
 Senior\-level engagement with our most important customers. Building account plans, deepening relationships, expanding share of wallet.
 


 Export Strategy \& Build\-out
 
 Diagnose, design, and execute the right go\-to\-market model for each export cluster — sales agents, distributors, country managers, or hybrid structures. The strategy is yours to design with the CEO.
 


 Digital Commerce Direction
 
 Lead the strategic review and evolution of our UAE digital commerce platform — its role, its model, its growth path.
 


 Sales Organisation Design
 
 Within 90 days, you will deliver a structured proposal for how the commercial team should be shaped to win — segmentation, KAM ownership, territory design, capability gaps.
 


 Pricing Governance
 
 Define discount bands, channel pricing rules, and approval matrices. Defend margin against pricing pressure.
 


 Team Building \& Performance
 
 Lead, assess, and upgrade the commercial team. Hire where needed. Coach, develop, and hold people accountable.
 



  




 What You BringMust Have
 
 •      10\+ years of commercial experience, with at least 5 years at Head / Director / Country Manager level carrying full P\&L (revenue AND margin)
 



 •      Career built on the distributor side of the transaction — you've owned inventory, appointed channel partners, managed trade terms, taken margin risk
 



 •      Industry background in professional AV, pro audio, musical instruments, or PA systems distribution (or directly adjacent: ELV systems distribution — CCTV, access control, fire alarm, structured cabling)
 



 •      Meaningful UAE or GCC commercial experience with existing channel relationships in the trade community
 



 •      Proven experience running both UAE/GCC domestic channels AND export markets — not one or the other
 



 •      Track record of building commercial systems from scratch — CRM rollouts, pricing frameworks, dealer hierarchies, territory design
 



 •      Comfort building or rebuilding a sales team or agent network from a low base
 



 •      Currently in UAE or able to relocate within 30 days
 



  




 Strong Preferences
 
 •      Native or fluent Arabic
 



 •      Experience in lean, owner\-managed organisations (under 150 people)
 



 •      Founder, co\-founder, or owner\-operator background in a distribution or trading business
 



 •      Africa export experience (East, West, or Central)
 



 •      Experience managing exclusive distribution or sole\-agency agreements
 



 •      Familiarity with brands in our portfolio or our competitive set
   




 What Success Looks Like
 
 By the end of your first 12 months, you will have:
 



 •      Taken full operational ownership of the commercial engine
 



 •      Implemented CRM discipline, pricing governance, and pipeline visibility
 



 •      Delivered structured strategies for the team, exports, and digital commerce
 



 •      Driven measurable revenue growth across UAE and export markets
 



 •      Deepened relationships with our top accounts and opened new significant ones
 



 •      Built or upgraded the commercial team for the next phase
 



 By the end of 24 months, the business runs on a commercial operating system that no longer requires founder presence in day\-to\-day execution — and you've created room for the next stretch.
 



  




 Compensation \& Benefits
 
 •      
 **Starting salary:** 
 AED 25,000 – 30,000 per month, all\-inclusive (depending on experience)
 



 •      
 **Structured 12\-month review:** 
 On delivery of Year\-One outcomes, total compensation potential of up to AED 35,000 – 40,000 per month inclusive of variable performance components
 



 •      
 **Performance variable:** 
 Gross margin\-based commission designed for meaningful upside on outperformance
 



 •      
 **Strategic bonus:** 
 Performance\-linked discretionary bonus tied to business profitability and named strategic milestones
 



 •      
 **Benefits:** 
 Per UAE Labour Law — visa, medical insurance, workmen's compensation, annual home leave ticket, end\-of\-service gratuity, 30 days annual leave
 



 •      
 **Tools:** 
 Laptop, mobile plan, vehicle allowance, expense account
 



  




 How to Apply
 
 If this sounds like the next chapter of your career, apply directly via the link below — no CV required upfront. The application takes approximately 5 minutes. You will be asked a short set of screening questions and may be invited to a brief AI\-led interview — please answer honestly, as your responses form part of how we shortlist for the next round.
 



 Shortlisted candidates can expect:
 



 1\.    Equip AI interview (\~30 min)
 



 2\.    Intro call with the CEO
 



 3\.    A full Topgrading career interview (90–120 minutes) covering your full work history
 



 4\.    Reference checks with at least 3 past managers
 



 5\.    A final meeting with our Managing Director
 



 6\.    Final compensation and start\-date discussion
 



 We move quickly when we find the right person. We are deliberate when we don't.
 



  




 A Note on Our Hiring Process
 
 We use the Topgrading hiring methodology because we believe most hiring failures come from rushing the assessment. Our interviews are thorough, our reference checks are real, and our scorecard is honest about what success looks like in this role. The strongest candidates appreciate this approach — it ensures both sides know what they're signing up for.

* Be able to manage a team of one or more planning engineers, providing them with technical and leadership skills.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

 **Global Program Engineer Manager \- Digitalization.**

* Define and own the global PMO governance model for post‑order execution across all regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC).

* Ensure governance rigor for large, complex, and multi‑site data center programs, including hyperscale and strategic customer engagements.
* Act as the central authority for program health reviews, executive escalations, and cross‑regional issue resolution.

* Define global requirements for program visibility, KPI reporting, risk management, and forecast accuracy.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
This role is designed for academic leaders who prefer building the system over critiquing it from the outside. Your subject mastery allows you to recognize high\-quality learning, your rigor enables you to translate that insight into rubrics and AI\-driven quality controls, and your pragmatism ensures you can act decisively on incomplete data. Student improvement is your primary concern, and you are prepared to be measured by that standard.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning pursues an approach that most software and education companies avoid. Teachers, textbooks, and the familiar scaffolding of traditional instruction are absent from the product. AI serves as the operational foundation. In this position, you deploy it to create and refine learning content, architect interventions, oversee quality, and advance the platform. The work tempo resembles high\-performance tech, consulting, or banking environments more than typical education settings, and the reward is direct accountability for a subject's student outcomes across multiple campuses.
   

  

 This is a functional leadership role. You will develop AI\-powered enhancements to the learning ecosystem, react to student\-performance data with targeted interventions, produce evidence\-backed decision records, and lead a team according to explicit standards linked to MAP, AP, SAT, and ISEE performance. Collaboration with product, engineering, and data science teams to shape platform priorities is central. The role suits someone who defaults to AI, conducts their own analysis, delivers work amid uncertainty, and takes full ownership of outcomes. Anyone who favors consensus\-driven timelines, minimal accountability, or the security of established systems will find it frustrating.
   

  

 You will serve as a key leader within the academics team, wielding genuine influence over your subject's performance and the evolution of the broader learning system. Your colleagues will depend on your standards, judgment, and capacity to translate student data into action. If that prospect excites rather than intimidates you, this role was built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Learning Ecosystem Enhancements — AI\-generated refinements to K–12 subject\-specific learning experiences, spanning content, adaptive pathways, and student interventions, shaped by student feedback, analytics, assessments, and coaching observations.
* Data\-Driven Academic Interventions — Focused intervention strategies for students or cohorts falling behind, informed by MAP, AP, SAT, ISEE, and related performance metrics.
* Student Performance Decision Records — Repeatable, evidence\-supported decisions that document actions taken to improve student performance, backed by dashboards, analytics, tickets, surveys, coaching calls, and assessment results.
* Learning Ecosystem Improvement Specs — Implementation\-ready specifications for product, engineering, and data science enhancements, featuring problem statements, supporting evidence, projected student impact, and acceptance criteria.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Repackaging traditional education in an AI wrapper. This isn't about replicating classroom instruction via screens – we're fundamentally reimagining learning from the ground up.
* Analyzing data in isolation. You'll be expected to regularly engage with K\-12 students, valuing their feedback as essential input from our paying customers.
* Waiting for consensus to push boundaries. You'll champion a bold vision and rally others around data\-driven results.
* Sticking to conventional methods. You'll be free to experiment with innovative approaches to motivation, assessment, and instruction.
* Fearing AI's impact on education. Here, you'll harness AI as an exciting tool to revolutionize learning, not as a threat to be mitigated.


**Director Of Learning Key Responsibilities**
 Lead innovation in AI\-powered, teacher\-less education to produce outstanding student outcomes across multiple campuses. Combine data analytics with consistent student engagement to continuously refine our learning ecosystem, as reflected in AP exam performance and MAP assessment growth.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Master's degree or higher in Educational Science, Learning Science, Psychology, Psychometrics, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 5 years of experience in academic or EdTech leadership roles, with direct people management responsibility (hiring, performance evaluation, coaching, termination decisions)
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools as part of day\-to\-day professional workflows, and willingness to rely on AI extensively to improve academic and operational outcomes.
* Strong understanding of learning science principles, such as Cognitive Load Theory and Mayer's Multimedia Principles, and data\-driven educational approaches


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

In addition to commercial fit\-out experience, we are particularly interested in candidates who have successfully delivered smaller\-scale luxury residential and villa projects, demonstrating a strong appreciation for high\-end finishes, bespoke detailing, and exceptional quality standards.
 



 You will take full ownership of project delivery from planning through to execution and handover, ensuring all initiatives are completed within defined scope, timeline, and budget. We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package.
 



  





**We Welcome Everyone to Apply** 




  





 It takes diversity of thought, culture, background, abilities, and perspectives to truly enthuse and excite our customers. We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future.
 



 We would like to thank you in advance for your application. Due to the influx of applications, we don’t always get the opportunity to speak to our candidates. Consequently, if you haven’t been contacted over the next two weeks then you can assume you have not been successful on this occasion.

The School Of Business Administration At The American University Of Sharjah Is Looking For a Head Of Department (HoD) For Economics And a Head Of Department For Finance Starting Fall 2026\. The Responsibility And Accountability Of An HoD Are Described Below
   

  

 The Head of Department (HoD) coordinates the academic and administrative functions of the department. As the elected representative of the faculty, the HoD is entrusted with advancing the department’s best interests by fostering collective faculty decision\-making, ensuring transparency in governance, safeguarding curriculum quality, supporting faculty development, and effectively representing departmental perspectives within the college and the wider university.
   

  

 The Head of Department represents and ensures the well\-being of the department faculty, and promotes an environment that supports faculty members and students in their efforts to succeed. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Head of Department engages in collaborative leadership with the faculty according to the AUS shared governance model of academic administration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Academic Leadership
* Coordinates departmental curricula, scheduling and service assignments with faculty input, while overseeing curricular development, assessment and accreditation to ensure program quality and compliance.
* Holds accountability for programs, processes, data collection and reporting at the departmental level.
* Serves as an advocate of the department within the college/school and align broader university and college/school interests with departmental initiatives and activities.
* Promotes departmental programs internally and externally
* Faculty and Staff Development
* Mentors, evaluates and supports the professional development of faculty and staff, including structured faculty evaluations, annual staff evaluations and participation in faculty hiring.
* Encourages and facilitates the instructional and scholarly development of faculty
* Develops teaching schedules and service assignments, with consideration given to interests solicited from the faculty
* Student Experience
* Enhances the academic experience and addresses student concerns fairly and effectively.
* Governance and Compliance
* Reports to and be accountable to the Dean for departmental operations; represents departmental perspectives within college/school governance; fosters an environment of shared purpose, transparency and academic excellence; and ensures compliance with university policies and procedures.
* Resource and Program Management
* Manages departmental resources and budgets responsibly and transparently, in consultation with faculty, and promotes departmental programs internally and externally.
* Leads program accreditation efforts in the department
* Contributes to the assessment of and implementation of curricular changes


 Submissions of the CV and cover letter including prior relevant experience by those interested in the position are due on
 **Saturday, May 9th @ 5 pm.** 
 at
 **deanofsba@aus.edu**
**ABOUT THE SCHOOL:** 
 The School of Business Administration enrolls over 1,900 undergraduate and graduate students. QS World University Subject Rankings 2025 has named AUS number two (tied) in the UAE and among the top 300 universities globally for business and management studies, number one in the UAE (tied) and among the top 250 universities globally for accounting and finance, and number one (tied) in the UAE and top 400 universities globally in the category of economics and econometrics. The AUS MBA program is ranked second in the UAE, seventh (tied) in the Middle East and Africa region, and among the world's top 200 in the
 **QS Global MBA Rankings (2026\).** 
 The school offers a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration degree with majors in accounting, economics, finance, information systems and business analytics, management, marketing and supply chain management, as well as a Bachelor of Arts in Economics. Graduate degrees include the Master of Business Administration, Master of Business Data Analytics, Master of Science in Accounting, Master of Science in Economics and Policy, Master of Science in Finance, PhD in Finance and PhD in Management. The school has been accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) since April 2011\.
   

  

**ABOUT THE UNIVERSITY:** 
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility. Its rank among the top five universities with the highest percentage of international students (Times Higher Education, 2024\) is a testament to that ideal. AUS is licensed and its degree programs are
 **accredited** 
 by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.. Additionally, AUS has been accredited in the USA by the
 **Middle States Commission on Higher Education** 
 since June 2004\. In addition to the School of Business Administration, the university includes the College of Engineering, the College of Arts and Sciences, and the College of Architecture, Art and Design, serving more than 6,000 students from approximately 100 nationalities. The university curricula, teaching standards and employment norms are fully in tune with the American model of higher education.
   

  

 The AUS campus is located at the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and Sharjah International Airport, only 35 minutes away from Downtown Dubai and 20 minutes away from Dubai International Airport. For more information, please visit
 **www.aus.edu** 
 .
   

  

**ABOUT SHARJAH AND THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES:** 
 UAE is home to more than 10 million people from over 200 nationalities. Sharjah is the third most populous of the UAE’s seven emirates after Dubai and Abu Dhabi. For more information, see
 **https://u.ae/en/about\-the\-uae** 
 . Sharjah is widely regarded as a center of culture and education and serves as home to an industrious and dynamic population. Like the UAE, Sharjah provides a safe and comfortable environment that offers easy access to the UAE’s many beaches, the Hajar Mountains and a multitude of leisure establishments, all within a short driving distance. Given the country’s location and robust transportation infrastructure, travel to Asia, Africa and Europe is easy. These are advantages that are easily accessible given that Sharjah takes facilitating work\-life balance seriously as is evidenced by it having instituted a four\-day workweek.

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, etc. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website:www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





  





  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 This role is critical to deepening industry participation in Dubai’s RDI ecosystem by designing corporate incentive offerings that attract private investment and accelerate research commercialization. It helps translate research into market\-ready solutions and aligns corporate participation with Dubai’s RDI and economic priorities.
 



  





  





  





**Director \- Corporate Innovation \& RDI Partnerships** 




 As Director \- Corporate Innovation \& RDI Partnerships, you will define, integrate, and oversee programs that leverage corporate RDI incentives to attract private investment in Dubai\-based RDI activities. This role focuses on transforming research into market\-ready solutions and deepening industry participation in RDI activities.
 



 The Director will collaborate with internal teams and external partners, including corporates and government entities, to drive alignment with corporate incentivization priorities and offerings.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 • You will define a corporate RDI incentive offering that encourages companies, both local and global, to invest in Dubai\-based RDI activities
 



 • You will approve incentive allocations to corporates following a thorough assessment of their RDI proposals
 



 • You will identify and engage Dubai RDI ecosystem players that can offer complementary incentives, such as subsidized land and shared infrastructure
 



 • You will align corporate acceleration incentives and broader corporate RDI activities with Dubai’s RDI and economic priorities
 



 • You will monitor supported corporates’ performance against strategic metrics to track outcomes and impacts, and refine incentives based on derived insights
 



 • You will represent the organization at high\-level forums, showcasing corporate incentivization success stories
 



 • You will lead efforts to attract global and regional corporates and innovation\-driven enterprises to establish or expand RDI activities in Dubai.
 



 • You will establish and manage strategic partnerships across government, industry, academia, investors, and innovation ecosystem stakeholders to strengthen Dubai’s RDI landscape.
 



 • You will develop governance frameworks and evaluation criteria to ensure effective allocation of incentives and measurable economic impact.
 



 • You will support commercialization pathways, regulatory readiness, technology adoption, and scalable market deployment of RDI outcomes
 



  





  





  





**Why this role is important?** 




 This role is key to attracting and mobilizing private\-sector investment into Dubai’s RDI ecosystem. By structuring corporate incentives, guiding commercialization pathways, and aligning company activity with strategic priorities, it accelerates innovation adoption, strengthens public\-private collaboration, and translates RDI into measurable economic impact.
 



  





  





  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with people who are passionate about the future and establishing Dubai as one of the leading cities of the world. You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas, and innovation.
 



  





  





  





**Who We're Looking For?** 




 • You will have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, STEM, Policy, or a related field; advanced qualifications are preferred
 



 • You will have 12\+ years of experience leading large\-scale innovation, corporate R\&D, corporate business development, tech acceleration programs or economic development agencies.
 



 • You will have a strong understanding of industry trends within RDI, emerging technologies, and best practices in corporate innovation
 



 • You will have familiarity with public\-private partnership models, corporate innovation funding mechanisms, or regulatory innovation
 



 • You will have excellent leadership, project management, and strategic planning skills, with a record of driving measurable outcomes
 



 • You will have a demonstrated history of executive stakeholder management in a multinational landscape and ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders.
 



 • You will have familiarity with financial models and performance metrics for evaluating corporate RDI impact
 



 • Proficiency in Arabic is a plus

**Role: Senior Director, AI Commercial Business Partner \- International**

**About AstraZeneca**
 At AstraZeneca, we are proud of our ground\-breaking pipeline and continue to look for new ways to bring the best medicines to patients. We are building and fostering high\-performing collaborative teams across the organization to help us deliver on our ambition. There’s no better time to join our global, growing enterprise as we lead the way for patients, healthcare and broader society.
   

  

**AI Commercial Team (AIC)**
 The AI Commercial team, is part of the newly founded Enterprise AI team (EAI), delivering AI strategy and coordinated commercial progress and programs, in close collaboration with our business teams, and in partnership with our enterprise teams. We lead cross\-functional and commercial\-wide initiatives to deliver transformative commercial value and ensure we are at our best in delivering lifesaving medicines to patients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 AI Commercial Business Leaders are the embedded “translators” between business functions and the AI Commercial organization, responsible for the success of AI programs. The role is strategically positioned in therapy areas, markets, and functions with the objectives to drive translation, adoption, and lifecycle management of AI solutions in the business.
   

  

 Key deliverables include translating business needs into well\-scoped AI use cases and ensure each solution delivers measurable business impact. This requires you to be bilingual in business/science and technology, enabling you to connect domain priorities with AI delivery teams. You will be responsible for owning the full lifecycle of AI solutions \- from ideation through delivery, adoption, and decommissioning \- and are accountable for driving real, sustained value and reuse.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for building the bridge between business teams at a Region and Market level, and technical experts within the AIC and EAI function as well as key other Enterprise technology teams such as Commercial IT and Global Business Services. As part of this role, you will champion the key commercial AI programs in service of enhancing customer engagement, powered by actionable AI insights, delivered thought agentic platforms. In addition, you will partner on the delivery of AI capability building programs.
   

  

 To do this successfully, you will share geographic location with the respective Region team, have a seat at the Senior leader table for the Region, with connection further enhanced through dotted line reporting to the Region, while sitting on the AIC Leadership team reporting to VP AIC.
   

  

 The International region is the largest, most diverse and fastest growing region in AstraZeneca. It has over 28,000 employees across more than 75 markets, spanning many different cultures and languages. Areas it includes are: Middle East \& Africa, South America, Asia and Australasia.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Strategy and portfolio ownership of new AI Commercial programs for in partnership with the business teams.
* Single point of contact and responsible for engagement for AI Commercial capabilities programs for the Region, maintaining AI roadmaps aligned with business needs, developing business cases in partnership with the business, and promoting reuse principles.
* Translation of needs into AI use cases: Engaging with stakeholders to identify unmet needs and translating these into well\-defined AI use cases with clear metrics and requirements and a clear alignment with business strategy and AI30 focus areas.
* Delivery, scale, adoption and value tracking of AI initiatives: co\-leading solution delivery, overseeing lifecycle management including pilot shaping, deployment, adoption, and value realization, while ensuring appropriate evidence frameworks are applied.
* Change management and governance: Acting as change leaders embedding AI into operations, support AI literacy, and ensure data governance and compliance with standards and regulations, while collaborating with internal and external partners to drive commercial success at scale.
* Translating business needs into well\-scoped AI use cases and ensuring each solution delivers measurable business impact. This requires you to be bilingual in business and technology, enabling you to connect domain priorities with AI delivery teams. Owning the full lifecycle of AI solutions \- from ideation through delivery, adoption, and decommissioning.
* Spot and shape new enterprise initiatives by scanning internal/external trends and partnering with functional leaders.
* Track industry, market and innovation shifts to anticipate opportunities and risks.
* Lead change through structured stakeholder engagement, aligning perspectives and guiding teams through uncertainty.
* Define KPIs and monitoring to evaluate progress and pivot when needed.


**Typical Accountabilities Include**
* AI Strategy and portfolio ownership
+ Serve as the single business owner for AI solutions in their therapy area, market, or function.
+ Maintain and sequence a clear AI roadmap aligned to business, medical, access, and R\&D priorities.
+ Develop business cases and value narratives to support prioritization decisions.
+ Embed reuse principles ("build or buy once, scale to many") when defining and shaping demand.

* Translation of needs into AI use cases
+ Engage business leaders and cross\-functional teams to surface unmet needs and decision points where AI can drive new outcomes.
+ Translate needs into well\-scoped AI use cases with clear problem statements, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiering.
+ Act as bilingual translators connecting business priorities, scientific context, and technology capabilities.

* Delivery, scale, adoption and value tracking
+ Co\-lead delivery with enterprise AI teams to ensure solutions fit real workflows and local systems.
+ Own the full AI Program lifecycle, including:
+ Pilot shaping
+ Scaled deployment
+ Local adoption and change readiness
+ Tracking of adoption KPIs
+ Outcome and ROI realization
+ Remediation or decommissioning when needed
+ Ensure correct evidence frameworks are applied to measure value.

* Change management and ways of working
+ Act as change leaders for AI, embedding new practices into day\-to\-day operations – avoiding one\-off pilots that don’t inform or lead to a scaled solution
+ Identify required process and role shifts and work with functional leaders to implement them, in order to advance adoption of AI solutions.
+ Support AI literacy and upskilling by partnering with the AITO team and HR on targeted learnings.

* Data, governance and compliance point of contact for the International region
+ Partner with Enterprise Demand Excellence (EDE) and AITT to ensure data used in solutions is AI\-ready and compliant with enterprise standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI act, SAMd).
+ Ensure each AI use case follows the enterprise governance framework, including:

+ Ensure AI solutions align with quality, legal, compliance, PV and safety requirements, and local codes.

* Deliver Partnership and ecosystem
* Clear co\-development of AI programs and delivery plans, ensuring business maintains sponsorship and ownership from inception to delivery and scaling.

* Build a culture of coordinated delivery with pride, shared purpose and celebration. Supporting a culture of co\-delivery and ability to raise and address concerns in a psychologically safe environment.

* Act as the primary interface between your business area and CAI Capability teams (Customer and Patient Engagement, Commercial DS\&AI) and Enterprise AI teams (i.e., AISI, AITC, AICA, AIEI, AITT, EDE), ensuring clarity on ownership, priorities and hand\-offs.


**Essential For The Role**
* Substantial proven experience leading transformation programs in commercial pharma.
* Demonstrated commercial and scientific domain experience reflecting a deep understanding of the needs of the business function and Region you are responsible for.
* Strong analytical and communication skills at all levels of the organization and the ability to operate successfully in highly matrixed organizations

 Senior role within the Real Estate Finance team with the purpose of originating and executing Real Estate Finance transactions for CIB clients of the Bank and to support the real estate transactions of wider REF team globally.  Work closely with all departments of the Bank to ensure deal opportunities are activated and communication is harmonised.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




 The role encompasses, enhancing the bank's capabilities in the real estate finance covering all forms of RE finance structures in addition to identifying opportunities for equity origination and deal placement. This will involve:
 


* Meeting clients/sponsors.
* Originating, structuring and executing new deals along with the coverage \& credit team.
* Thoroughly review the existing CRE loan book and identify opportunities to secure existing loans business through a combination of refinance and restructuring.
* Build a platform for growth to support new business initiatives across the FAB footprint.
