Location: Iraq
 



 Sector: Hospitality, mixed use, destination development
 



 Employment type: Full\-time, permanent, hybrid
 



 Client: Owner / Investor
 



  





**The opportunity** 




  





 A confidential private development group is seeking a Development Director to lead a major hospitality\-led real estate development in Iraq.
 



  





 This is a senior client\-side role focused on the planning, structuring, and progression of a landmark destination scheme including hotel, resort, residential, wellness, leisure, retail, infrastructure, and public realm components.
 



  





 Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, the Development Director will be responsible for driving the development strategy, coordinating consultants and operators, managing design progression, and ensuring the project is commercially, operationally, and technically aligned as it moves through early\-stage development and into delivery readiness.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 The Development Director will lead the development planning and execution strategy across a complex destination project, working closely with senior leadership, investors, hotel operators, branded residence partners, design consultants, technical advisors, commercial teams, and future delivery teams.
 



  





 Key responsibilities will include:
 


* Leading the overall development strategy, asset positioning, phasing, and land use planning
* Managing hospitality, resort, branded residence, wellness, leisure, and supporting real estate components
* Coordinating hotel operator engagement, technical services requirements, brand standards, and approval processes
* Managing master planners, architects, engineers, hospitality designers, cost consultants, and specialist advisors
* Overseeing design progression from master planning through concept, schematic, detailed design, and tender preparation
* Supporting development appraisals, feasibility studies, financial models, investment papers, and development budgets
* Establishing governance, reporting structures, milestone tracking, and decision making processes
* Working across legal, finance, marketing, sales, leasing, hospitality, operations, and delivery functions
* Managing external stakeholders, consultants, operators, investors, lenders, and regulatory bodies
* Supporting the transition from development planning into procurement and construction readiness



  





**The candidate** 




  




* Candidates should bring substantial client side development experience across large scale real estate, hospitality, resort, branded residence, or mixed use projects.
* The successful candidate is likely to have:
* 15 years or more of experience in real estate development, hospitality development, resort development, or mixed use destination projects
* A track record leading projects through master planning, design development, commercial structuring, and pre construction stages
* Direct experience working with international hotel operators, hospitality brands, and branded residence partners
* Strong understanding of hospitality development economics, feasibility analysis, operator requirements, and asset positioning
* Experience managing multidisciplinary consultant teams across planning, design, commercial, technical, and delivery workstreams
* Strong commercial judgement, financial literacy, and stakeholder management capability
* Previous experience in the Middle East, emerging markets, or complex international development environments
* A background in architecture, engineering, urban planning, real estate, construction management, hospitality development, or a related field
* This role would suit a senior development professional who can operate with ownership, structure ambiguity, manage multiple stakeholders, and bring a hospitality led destination through early development into a deliverable project.



  





**To apply** 




 Click the link below to submit your CV for consideration. For a confidential briefing, please reach out to Matthew Donovan at MRG Global (Matthew.Donovan@mrgglobal.com)

data.jd_text:
**TGP International**
 WE CREATE, DESIGN AND BUILD AWARD WINNING WORLD\-CLASS F\&B AND RETAIL BRANDS FOR OUR CLIENTS AND PARTNERS
   

  

 TGP International are a hospitality consultancy based in London and Dubai. We team up with passionate brands, clients and entrepreneurs to make their long\-term vision a reality through concept development, creative interior design, graphic design \& branding, franchising, advisory \& operational services and project management.
   

  

 Some of our clients include: Dubai Expo 2020, Marriott, Hilton, Waldorf Astoria, Harrods, Sushi Samba, Adrift Burger Bar, Nakheel Malls, Selfridges, Time Out Market, FIFA World Cup 2022, The National, and Tashas.
   

  

**Do you have a real passion for food and hospitality? Are you a foodie? Does the idea of creating world\-class restaurants, food halls and F\&B excite you?**
 As the world's leading hospitality agency, offering an outstanding 360 degree service to our clients, we are constantly striving to be the best and lead the sector in F\&B and hospitality consultancy. We need a driven and creative person to join our fun and dynamic team and have a direct contribution and client exposure on some of the world's leading projects.
   

  

**Requirements**
**The Role:** 
 Strategy \& Masterplanning Director
   

  

**The job location can be from any of our offices: London, Cairo, Dubai, Riyadh**
 The Strategy \& Masterplanning Director is responsible for leading and growing TGP's Strategy \& Masterplanning practice, ensuring the successful delivery of all strategic advisory projects while driving innovation, client satisfaction, commercial performance, and team development.
   

  

 As a senior client advisor, the Director will build trusted relationships with clients, taking the time to deeply understand their challenges, ambitions, operational realities, and commercial objectives. They will be responsible for translating complex business problems into clear strategic questions, designing analytical approaches that uncover actionable insights, and developing tailored solutions that create measurable value for clients.
   

  

 The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams through large\-scale research, data analysis, market evaluation, and strategic planning processes, transforming complex findings into compelling narratives, creative strategies, and inspirational recommendations that distinguish TGP from traditional consultancies.
   

  

 The role will also play a key part in growing TGP's market presence by identifying opportunities to expand client relationships, develop new service offerings, and position TGP as the leading hospitality strategy and experience consultancy in the region.
   

  

 The Director is responsible for upholding TGP's values, maintaining the reputation of the Advisory department, and acting as a champion of TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Strategy, Masterplanning \& Client Advisory


**Strategic Leadership**
* Lead the development, delivery and implementation of client\-facing hospitality strategy projects including:
* Master Planning
* Feasibility Studies
* Throughput Analysis
* Management Consultancy Services
* Operational Consultancy Services
* Brand Curation Services
* Market Assessments
* Concept Development
* Destination Strategy
* Asset Positioning
* Act as the senior strategic advisor on all strategy projects
* Lead project scoping, methodology development, timelines, resource planning, and delivery frameworks
* Provide final review and approval of all strategic outputs, recommendations, reports, and presentations
* Drive the evolution of TGP's strategic advisory services, methodologies, tools, and intellectual property


**Client Management \& Relationship Development**
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships founded on trust, credibility, and strategic value
* Invest time in understanding client businesses, operational challenges, investment objectives, stakeholder priorities, and market context
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and stakeholder engagement sessions to identify root causes of business challenges rather than simply responding to stated requirements
* Translate client needs into tailored strategic solutions that align with commercial, operational, and brand objectives
* Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships through cross\-selling, upselling, and introduction of wider TGP services
* Position TGP as a strategic partner rather than a transactional consultant


**Problem Definition \& Analytical Leadership**
* Lead teams through structured problem\-solving methodologies to clearly define client challenges and project objectives
* Design analytical frameworks and research methodologies that support evidence\-based decision making
* Guide teams through large and complex data analysis exercises, including market, operational, financial, customer, and competitive data
* Ensure insights are derived from data in a way that remains focused on solving client business problems rather than simply reporting findings
* Challenge assumptions and identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, and innovation opportunities
* Drive clarity and alignment when working with ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting information


**Insight\-Led Strategy \& Innovation**
* Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable strategic recommendations
* Develop creative and inspirational strategies that combine commercial rigour with innovative thinking
* Ensure recommendations are grounded in insight while pushing clients towards differentiated and future\-focused solutions
* Lead the creation of compelling strategic narratives that inspire confidence and support decision making
* Champion innovation, thought leadership, and trend analysis to ensure TGP remains ahead of industry developments
* Create strategic outputs that differentiate TGP from traditional consultancies through a combination of insight, creativity, practicality, and implementation focus
* Test new methodologies, technologies, and approaches while tracking effectiveness and outcomes
* Actively participate in TGP's 360 process from a strategic perspective
* Attend weekly Advisory and Design meetings to update leadership on project performance, team workload, and strategic opportunities
* Finance \& Profitability
* Monitor project billing, collection, and financial performance
* Develop and contribute to territory business plans and growth strategies
* Maximise revenue opportunities across strategy projects and wider TGP services
* Ensure profitability targets and project margins are achieved
* Negotiate third\-party consultant fees and supplier agreements
* Assess project feasibility and risk prior to partner approval
* Develop management information systems and performance reporting to support business growth and resource planning
* Contribute to annual budgeting and forecasting processes
* Review quarterly forecasts and identify performance variances
* Monitor territory profit and loss performance and recommend corrective actions where required
* Project Leadership


 (Where assigned as Project Lead)
   

  

* Coordinate and chair project meetings
* Manage project programmes, deliverables, and stakeholder communications
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to TGP quality standards
* Attend site visits, workshops, and client presentations
* Provide strategic leadership and subject matter expertise throughout project delivery
* Manage relationships with all external stakeholders
* Obtain stakeholder feedback and approvals as required
* Facilitate collaboration across TGP departments to ensure integrated project delivery
* Ensure strategic recommendations remain aligned with brand, commercial, and operational objectives
* Manage effective project handover between departments and project phases
* People Leadership
* Lead recruitment, retention, and development of the Strategy \& Masterplanning team
* Approve all strategy team recruitment decisions
* Develop workforce planning and resource allocation strategies
* Mentor and coach team members in consulting, analytical thinking, client management, and strategic problem solving
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Conduct monthly team meetings and regular performance reviews
* Develop personal development plans and career pathways for team members
* Lead intern and graduate development programmes
* Ensure resources are effectively managed to meet client commitments
* Communicate resource requirements and capacity challenges to the Leadership Team
* Business Development \& Market Growth
* Actively build market presence through conferences, industry events, thought leadership, and networking activities
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and generate new business opportunities
* Lead strategic pitches, proposals, and presentations
* Support marketing initiatives with market insights, project learnings, and thought leadership content
* Maintain awareness of market trends, investor activity, hospitality innovation, and competitive movements
* Drive client retention, satisfaction, and long\-term relationship growth through TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy
* Promote TGP's integrated 360 service offering across all client engagements
* Contribute to positioning TGP as the leading hospitality strategy, masterplanning, and experience consultancy in the region


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Economics, Real Estate, Urban Planning, Architecture, Strategy, or a related discipline
* Master's Degree (MBA or equivalent) desirable


**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years' experience in hospitality consulting, real estate advisory, strategy consulting, destination development, or management consultancy
* Minimum 2 years in a senior leadership role
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale strategic advisory projects
* Strong understanding of GCC hospitality, tourism, mixed\-use, and destination development sectors
* Experience managing senior client relationships and executive stakeholders
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex analytical and strategic challenges


**Technical Skills \& Knowledge**
* Strategic Planning \& Business Transformation
* Hospitality \& Destination Strategy
* Masterplanning \& Feasibility Analysis
* Financial Modelling \& Commercial Analytics
* Market Research \& Data Analysis
* Client Relationship Management
* Facilitation \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Innovation \& Concept Development
* Business Development \& Proposal Writing
* GCC Market Knowledge
* Presentation \& Storytelling Skills
* Leadership \& Team Development


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Commercial Acumen
* Client Centricity
* Analytical Problem Solving
* Creativity \& Innovation
* Executive Presence
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Communication \& Storytelling
* Leadership \& Coaching
* Collaboration \& Team Building
* Results Orientation


**Benefits**
 TGP International Employee Benefits:
   

  

 Five\-Day Work Week: Standard Monday to Friday schedule.
   

  

 Hybrid Work Arrangement: Three days in the office and two days working remotely.
   

  

 Incentive Plan: Company incentive scheme offering up to 10%—5% for introductions and 5% for successful closures.
   

  

 Annual Leave: 22 working days of paid annual leave, excluding weekends.
   

  

 Remote Work Flexibility: One additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave.
   

  

 Coaching \& Mentoring: Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program.
   

  

 Annual Company Gathering: A global team event bringing together employees from all offices.
   

  

 Employee Recognition Program: Regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions.

As a Manager – Audit \& Assurance at Alkazim, you will independently manage a portfolio of audit and assurance engagements while leading and developing the audit team.  This role is designed to take ownership of day\-to\-day engagement management, allowing Partners to focus on strategic oversight and final sign\-off. It is suited to a commercially minded audit professional who thrives in a growing SME firm environment and is seeking a clear path toward Director and Partner.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Independently manage a portfolio of audit and assurance clients
* Plan and execute statutory audits, interim audits, escrow audits, JOP audits and service charge audits
* Review working papers and ensure audit files are complete prior to Partner review
* Identify engagement risks and ensure appropriate audit procedures are performed
* Manage timelines, budgets and resource allocation across multiple assignments
* Supervise and mentor audit associates and seniors
* Act as primary point of contact for clients and manage expectations
* Resolve routine technical matters and escalate complex issues where required
* Identify opportunities for upselling and contribute to business development initiatives
* Ensure compliance with International Standards on Auditing and UAE regulatory requirements
* Support continuous improvement of audit methodology and internal processes


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* ACCA qualified or equivalent professional qualification
* Minimum 5–7 years of audit experience
* Proven experience managing audit engagements independently
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing
* Experience with UAE mainland and free zone audits
* Prior exposure to escrow, service charge or similar assurance assignments preferred
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop junior team members
* Commercial mindset with strong client management skills
* Ability to manage multiple engagements in a fast\-paced environment


**What We Offer**
* Leadership role within a growing Audit \& Assurance practice
* Direct exposure to Partners and strategic decision\-making

**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.

* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a proactive and experienced Mid\-Level IT Project Manager in Sharjah to lead and coordinate IT and digital transformation projects. The ideal candidate will manage project execution, stakeholder communication, timelines, risks, vendors, and delivery quality while ensuring alignment with business objectives and client expectations.
 



 The role requires strong project coordination skills, hands\-on follow\-up, and the ability to work within multicultural environments and fast\-paced customer engagements.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of IT projects from initiation to closure.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Coordinate internal teams, subcontractors, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Monitor project scope, budget, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Conduct regular project meetings and prepare meeting minutes/action trackers.
* Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and drive mitigation plans.
* Ensure compliance with project governance, processes, and quality standards.
* Support change request management and impact assessments.
* Track project deliverables and ensure timely execution.
* Communicate project progress and escalations to management and clients.
* Support procurement, technical coordination, UAT, testing, and handover activities.
* Ensure proper project documentation and reporting.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Experience managing medium\-scale IT infrastructure, software, systems integration, or smart technology projects.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies (Waterfall / Agile / Hybrid).
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with government entities
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
* Vendor and subcontractor management experience.
* Familiarity with MS Project.
* Strong communication in English (Arabic is a plus)
* Flexiblility to work with multiple time zones in Europe and US
* Valid UAE driving license and access to a personal vehicle

data.jd_text:
Project Director – Roads \& Infrastructure
 



 Overview
 



 A leading main contractor in the UAE is looking to appoint an experienced Project Director to lead the successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the region.
 



 The business has an established presence within the infrastructure sector and is currently delivering a portfolio of large\-scale developments including highways, bridges, utilities, public realm, and civil infrastructure works. This role will suit a commercially and operationally driven leader with extensive experience managing complex infrastructure projects from mobilisation through to handover.
 



 The Role
 



 As Project Director, you will hold full responsibility for the overall delivery, commercial performance, programme management, and stakeholder coordination of major infrastructure projects. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage client relationships, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead the delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE
* Manage full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through to completion and handover
* Oversee project planning, programme management, construction strategy, and execution
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual, commercial, and operational objectives
* Lead and manage project teams including construction, engineering, commercial, planning, and HSE functions
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors
* Drive project performance across cost, programme, quality, safety, and risk management
* Monitor commercial performance, budgets, cash flow, and forecasting alongside commercial teams
* Lead progress meetings and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, contract requirements, and company standards
* Support business development activities and contribute to future project opportunities
* Mentor and develop senior project staff within the business



 Project Focus
 



 This role is predominantly focused on:
 


* Roads and highway infrastructure
* Utilities and drainage networks
* Bridges and civil engineering works
* Public realm and infrastructure developments
* Large\-scale government and infrastructure projects



 Candidate Requirements
 



 To be considered for this role, candidates should have:
 


* Proven experience working as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager within a main contractor environment
* Strong background delivering major roads and infrastructure projects in the UAE
* Extensive knowledge of civil engineering construction methodologies and project delivery
* Experience managing large multidisciplinary teams on complex infrastructure developments
* Strong commercial awareness and contract management experience
* Excellent stakeholder management and leadership capabilities
* Ability to manage programme delivery within fast\-paced project environments
* Strong communication, reporting, and client\-facing skills
* UAE experience is essential
* Strong public speaking and presentation skills
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline
* 16–18 years’ experience within roads and infrastructure construction



 What's on Offer
 


* Opportunity to lead high\-profile infrastructure developments across the UAE
* Long\-term career progression within a well\-established main contractor
* Exposure to complex, large\-scale civil engineering projects
* Senior leadership role with significant project and operational responsibility
* Dynamic and collaborative working environment



 If you are an experienced infrastructure professional looking to lead major civil engineering projects within a leading contractor environment, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.


**Role Requirements**
**Education :** 
 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

data.jd_text:
**About Woods Bagot – Architecture for Worlds Ahead** 




 We design places that meet the challenges and opportunities of our rapidly changing world. Our commitment to exploration, impact and community creates enduring, forward‑thinking outcomes, unlocking humanity’s highest potential. With a global design culture devoted to creativity, resilience, and purpose – we ensure every project contributes to our client’s vision, inspiring future generations.
 



  





 Woods Bagot is part of the 7C Network. The 7C Network is an integrated network of design and architecture companies that provides “Total Place Design,” a holistic approach to creating transformative environments. It combines capabilities from its constituent brands – including Woods Bagot, ERA\-co, Impact Futures, and Customs Bureau – to offer services in placemaking, sustainability, architecture and interior design, and luxury concepts.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.
* Initially provide leadership on a significant rail infrastructure project, ensuring successful delivery against programme, budget, and design objectives.
* Manage project resources, budgets, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including architecture, engineering, planning, urban design, and specialist consultants.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, design coordination, and project review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and project governance processes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve project challenges.
* Support business development activities and contribute to the pursuit of new project opportunities.
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* 15\+ years' experience designing and delivering complex architectural projects.
* Previous experience working on rail projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale, design\-led projects with multiple stakeholders and complex coordination requirements.
* Experience working on transportation, rail, aviation, civic, mixed\-use, commercial, or other major development projects would be highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of architectural project delivery, including design management, consultant coordination, project planning, and contract administration.
* Excellent design leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Degree qualification in Architecture; professional registration or chartership is desirable.
* Experience working within the UAE or broader Middle East region, with an understanding of local project delivery processes and regulatory requirements.
* A collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring, developing, and inspiring team members.
* Strong appreciation of design quality, technical excellence, and the delivery of innovative architectural solutions.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Applicants are required to submit a resume and portfolio via our Project Leader \- Rail LinkedIn Job Post. Due to file upload restrictions we recommend providing a link to your portfolio within your resume. Applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or names from agencies. All personal data collected by us will be kept confidential and only used for recruitment purposes.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement: It is an essential requirement that at the time of applying for this position, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UAE.** 




  





**7C \- Total Place Design Network** 




 7C is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status. At 7C, we are committed to creating an environment where difference is celebrated, valued and respected, practices are equitable, and our people feel like they belong. We accept that none of us is smarter than all of us. We believe building a diverse workforce is the foundation to creativity and innovative design – it is only by working together that we can realise the potential of our people, clients and communities around us. Through our inclusive leadership and our truly global studio network, you will find your voice and have the support and flexibility required to bring your whole self to work and build an exceptional career.

**About Al Marwan Group** 




 Founded in 1978, Al Marwan Group is a diversified organization serving the construction, heavy machinery, Oil \& Gas, real estate, development, and hospitality sectors across the GCC. The Group operates through multiple business units and subsidiaries, delivering integrated solutions supported by strong operational expertise and a well\-established regional presence.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead large\-scale roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in delivering complex projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks. The role is responsible for overall project execution, commercial performance, stakeholder management, safety compliance, and on\-time project delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Leadership \& Delivery** 



* Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Develop and monitor project schedules, resource plans, and performance targets, implementing corrective actions where necessary.



**Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Oversee project financial performance, including budgeting, cost control, forecasting, procurement, and profitability.
* Administer contracts in accordance with FIDIC conditions, managing risks, claims, variations, and contractual obligations.
* Drive value engineering and operational efficiency initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.



**Stakeholder \& Authority Management** 



* Act as the primary liaison with clients, consultants, developers, and government authorities.
* Coordinate approvals, permits, NOCs, and project handovers with relevant UAE authorities.
* Lead project review meetings and provide regular progress updates to senior management and stakeholders.



**Quality, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure full compliance with HSE regulations, project specifications, and quality standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture and oversee the implementation of QA/QC procedures across all project phases.
* Maintain adherence to UAE regulations, contractual requirements, and industry best practices.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
* PMP Certification or equivalent professional project management qualification is highly preferred.
* Professional membership or chartership (ICE, ASCE, PMI, or equivalent) is advantageous.



**Experience** 



* 15–20 years of experience in heavy civil engineering and infrastructure construction.
* Minimum 7–10 years of recent UAE experience with leading contracting companies.
* Proven track record as Lead Project Manager on infrastructure projects.
* Extensive experience in bridges, highways, tunnels, earthworks, deep utility networks, and complex infrastructure developments.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong technical expertise in infrastructure construction methodologies and engineering practices.
* Comprehensive knowledge of FIDIC contracts, claims management, cost control, and commercial administration.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
* Exceptional leadership, decision\-making, conflict resolution, and crisis management capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English. Arabic language proficiency is an added advantage.
* Valid UAE Driving License.

Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi\-faceted jeweled bottles.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative \& luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
   

  

**Summary**

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience leading large\-scale highways, transport, and integrated infrastructure programmes, with the credibility to operate at executive level across clients, authorities, delivery teams, and business leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership for a portfolio of major transport and infrastructure programmes, aligning delivery priorities with business objectives, client needs, and regional market opportunities.
* Shape market positioning and support business growth through key account development, pursuit strategy, proposal leadership, and executive\-level client engagement.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.
* Work closely with peers and the broader leadership team in an effective and collaborative manner.


**Project \& Programme Management**
* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.
* Own programme performance against schedule, budget, margin, cash flow, and quality targets, with clear accountability for forecasting, financial control, and overall portfolio health.
* Drive programme controls including risk management, change control, reporting, KPI monitoring, schedule assurance, and recovery planning across multi\-package and multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.


**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.
* Support recruitment, succession planning, and retention strategies to strengthen long\-term capability across the transport and infrastructure business.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.

 As a Project Manager, you benefit from tailored support and dedicated training focused on both your professional and personal development, empowering you to make a direct impact on the business and your own career trajectory.
 



 Apgar is committed to fostering an atmosphere of trust, motivation, and well\-being, where professionalism and growth go hand in hand with a friendly, supportive workplace culture. Our international and multicultural teams are a core strength of our success.
 



  





**Your mission** 




  





 As a Project Manager, you will work within a team operating directly on a client project, reporting to a dedicated manager.
 



  





**Your role:** 




  





 • You own delivery of data, analytics, and AI engagements end\-to\-end — from discovery and scoping through design, build, UAT, and go\-live — under the supervision of your Project Director.
 



 • You act as the single point of accountability for the engagement and the client’s primary point of contact, building trusted\-advisor relationships with both business and IT stakeholders.
 



 • You define and monitor project scope, assumptions, workload estimates, planning, methodology, and steering\-committee reporting and material.
 



 • You contribute to stakeholder management, requirements gathering and functional design workshops across data domains — MDM, data integration, metadata, data quality, analytics, and GenAI use cases — translating business outcomes into solution requirements.
 



 • You oversee the quality of functional specifications, technical documentation, and deliverables, partnering closely with data architects, data engineers, analytics consultants, and ML/AI specialists on your team.
 



 • You drive solution validation — internal testing, UAT support, data reconciliation, and model evaluation where applicable — through to production deployment and hypercare.
 



 • You manage project economics: budget tracking, margin, resource allocation, change requests, dependencies and risk mitigation.
 



 • You contribute to Apgar UAE’s growth by identifying expansion opportunities within your accounts and feeding insights back into our offerings and methodology
 



  





**Presales :** 




  





 • You participate in pre\-sales activities and responses to RFPs/tenders.
 



 • You contribute to implementation cost estimation and project planning.
 



 • You contribute to drafting commercial proposals.
 



  





**Your profile :** 




  





 • You hold a higher education degree (Bachelor’s/Master’s level) and have at least 7 years of experience in a consulting firm or IT services company.
 



 • You have strong interpersonal, commercial, and managerial skills, and are able to manage a project holistically from business, financial, and human perspectives.
 



 • You have significant experience related to at least one of the following areas covered by our offerings: MDM, Metadata, Data Integration, AI/ML and Data Preparation.
 



  





**Why Join Apgar?** 




  





 • Be part of an international community of data experts
 



 • Work in a dynamic, fast\-growing, and innovative data environment
 



 • Benefit from a dedicated career coach and unlimited access to training platforms
 



 • Grow in a company that genuinely invests in people and expertise
 



  





**Perks \& Work Environment** 




  





 •Hybrid work model: 1–2 days remote per week \+ 2 weeks of remote work abroad
 



 •Benefits for major life events and year\-end celebrations
 



 •Competitive remuneration (fixed and variable packages)
 



 •Company\-supported training and career growth
 



 •Social and Family benefits (health insurance, annual visa, ticket)
 



 •Support for work\-life balance in a motivating and collegial workplace.
 



  





**Practical Information** 




  





 • Location: Dubai
 



 • Contract: Permanent / Full Time
 



 • Start date: As soon as possible
 



 • Compensation: Attractive package (fixed \+ variable), depending on profile
 



  





**Our recruitment process is transparent:** 




  





 • Initial CV screening conducted by a Recruitment Officer
 



 • Interview with the Recruitment Officer (20–45 minutes) to understand your motivations, assess alignment with our values, and review the key milestones of your professional background
 



 • Technical or functional interview, depending on the role, to assess your expertise including a business case (1 hour)
 



 • Interview with a manager (1 hour)
 



  





 As an ISO 27001 certified company, with strong security requirements for both our clients and ourselves, reference checks may be requested depending on the position and seniority level.
 



  





 We firmly believe in an ethical approach to recruitment, where every candidate is treated with consideration, fairness, and transparency throughout the selection process, with the aim of respecting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities.
 



 Therefore, all applications are welcome and reviewed, without distinction based on origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, or disability

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 We are looking for a Head of Finance, MEA, to plan, organize, lead and control the Finance activities for the Region in order to support the delivery of the required growth, revenue, profit, working capital, cash flow and EBIT objectives. You will be the finance business partner for regional leadership and play an essential role in providing financial information, analysis and recommendations to make strategically consistent and financially sound decisions.
   

  

 This role reports to VP MEA and to our Flexible Packaging Segment VP Finance.
   

  

**Where you’ll be**
 This role is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and execute the financial strategy for the MEA region, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
* Take full responsibility for financial reporting and controlling across the MEA region, delivering timely, accurate, and insightful analysis in line with Segment and Group reporting requirements.
* Lead and coordinate strategic and budget planning processes, ensuring clear targets, KPIs, and objectives are established and aligned with business goals.
* Ensure accurate forecasting to support effective decision\-making and long\-term planning.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and monitoring, including project costs, approvals, financing, cash flow, and return on investment. Regularly review existing investments to assess their continued viability.
* Drive working capital optimization by collaborating closely with country teams to improve inventory, receivables, payables, debt management, and capital project efficiency, ultimately maximizing cash flow and returns.
* Identify and manage foreign currency exposures to minimize risk and protect financial performance.
* Review and enhance financial processes and procedures, ensuring strong governance, data accuracy, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Provide financial analysis and support for divestments, restructuring, and expansion initiatives, including the development of robust financial models for strategic decision\-making.
* Ensure effective implementation of business and productivity improvement initiatives by establishing follow\-up and control mechanisms to track progress, savings, efficiency gains, and value creation.
* Support continuous process improvements and ERP transformation initiatives within Flexible Packaging MEA.
* Lead the Finance organization in MEA, delivering high\-quality operational finance services and business controlling. Build a capable, well\-structured team while fostering strong engagement and collaboration, and supporting regional business priorities.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field and / or a professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Strong experience in finance leadership on regional or multi country level or global context preferably in manufacturing or FMCG environment.
* Proven experience in managing and leading finance teams and functions with a strong business partnering ability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Resilience and willingness to win.
* Ability to assess, analyze and synthesize a great deal of information and simplify the complexities.
* Fluent in English, excellent communication skills with ability to establish credibility, respect and build strong working relationships.
* A leadership style aligned with Huhtamaki’s values: Care, Dare and Deliver.


**What We Offer In Return**
* Opportunity to make an impact: in this role you can truly bring value with your finance and business expertise to drive business performance, co\-develop the business strategy and direction while providing leadership to finance teams with build up talent and capabilities.
* A meaningful job: At Huhtamaki, we believe in protecting food, people and the planet. Our innovative and transformative solutions touch the daily lives of people everywhere.
* Development opportunities: We care for each other – and want to see our talent thrive and develop.
* Responsible employer: Sustainability is embedded in everything we do. We believe diverse teams fuel innovation. We invest in fostering an environment where everyone is safe both psychologically and physically and where diversity and inclusion are promoted through day\-to\-day behaviors, reinforced by our policies and practices.


 If this sounds like a good fit, then we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Join us. Help protect food, people and the planet.

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior technology leader to scale and expand our financial technology platform as the company expands across markets, products, partners, and regions.
 



  





 This role is suited for someone who can operate both strategically and hands\-on when needed, but whose main strength is building systems, teams, ownership models, and engineering discipline that do not depend on a single individual.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and platform operations.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, observability, and incident readiness across critical systems.
* Support the company’s cybersecurity posture across ISIEM, SOC, DLP, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat modelling, monitoring, incident response, and security awareness.
* Lead the practical adoption of Agentic AI across engineering and technology operations.
* Strengthen security, compliance, audit readiness, access controls, data protection, and secure SDLC practices.
* Build and mature NOC/SOC capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, escalation, and post\-incident reviews.
* Scale the platform and the technical team for geographical expansion, including multi\-market readiness, localisation needs, regulatory expectations, and infrastructure scalability.
* Manage technical relationships with third\-party providers of core services, including issuing processors, payment providers, banking partners, cloud vendors, security vendors, and integration platforms.
* Improve ownership models, documentation, Runbooks, SLAs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and help build a reliable leadership structure across engineering and operations.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 10\+ years Senior technology leadership experience in a roles VP Engineering/ Technology, Head of Engineering/Technology, or similar.
* Experience in fintech, specifically issuing, acquiring or banking is essential.
* Proven track record scaling reliable, secure, compliant production systems.
* Proven track record of the Agentic AI adaptation and productivity gain.
* Experience building engineering teams, technical operations, NOC/SOC processes, and delivery discipline.
* Experience with either ISO27001, SAMA, SOC2 and PCI DSS regulatory implementation and support.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, backend platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, disaster recovery and incident management.
* Experience working with third\-party providers of mission\-critical services.
* Ability to operate across strategy, architecture, execution, people leadership, and executive communication.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I (Cabin Technical and Reconfigurations) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Airframe/Mechanical Systems.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary.
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers
