data.jd_text:
The role holder is responsible for managing the FM operations and maintenance activities in accordance with defined DHAM FM standards and processes with the objective of enhancing customer satisfaction, minimizing customer complaints, and maximizing revenue and profitability of the respective DHAM entity.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**Support with Budgeting** 



* Assist the department head in the preparation of annual operation and capital budgets.
* Monitor budget and highlight budget variances to ensure cost efficiencies in line with the scorecard for OPEX saving and
* Execution of approved CAPEX project in a timely manner.



**FM Operations** 



* Manage the team of FM Executive and FM Service Provider team for smooth daily FM operations.
* Monitor of FM Service Provider in delivery of services including Soft Services (Cleaning, Pest Control, Landscaping waste management etc.) and hard services (including reactive and preventive maintenance, as well all specialized services for critical and non\-critical equipment and ensure work is carried out as per agreed SLA and prepare snag reports.
* Supervise activities within the assigned community/asset, conduct regular meetings with internal \& external teams to monitor progress of FM activities and to ensure compliance with the agreed standards and requirements.
* Conduct regular site visits and promptly address identified issues.
* Responsible and manages DHAM CAFM system (Maximo) and its utilization on respective site.
* Monitor and maintain records of utilities expenditure and implement initiatives of sustainability and utilities cost saving projects.
* Represent the business unit during design, planning, construction, and handover stages of the newly developed assets to oversee FM requirements.
* Oversee activities directly related to regulatory requirements of life safety systems and ensure necessary certifications are obtained on time.
* Assist the fit\-out activities in DHAM’s assets to ensure compliance with the scope of work, HSE requirements and building’s standards.
* Assist business partners and their contractors with details on the requirements related to technical aspects, FM issues, fit\-out process and issue the necessary permits.
* Ensure FM records are created and maintained for all assigned sites such as site logbooks to demonstrate full operational procedures are followed.
* Ensure effective use of CAFM to ensure all Service Requests and Work Orders are tracked for timely completion in line with SLA requirements.
* Ensure new DHAM assets being brought into operations are entered onto pre\-planned maintenance program and subject to QA procedures.
* Planning future enhancement requirements by forecasting the facility’s upcoming needs and requirements.
* Identify gaps and deficiencies in services, advice, and effect solutions as part of Continuous Improvement on FM services rendered.
* Explore and recommend innovative methods, based on best practices, in order to bring about cost\-effective solutions.
* Writes and provides monthly operational and technical reports.



**Tendering \& Procurement** 



* Prepare SOW documents for FM operational services for new buildings and conduct necessary technical evaluation of the submitted proposals.
* Prepare scope of work for (operational variables and capex projects).
* Initiate procurement process, liaise with procurement department during the tendering process, review vendor responses and issue GRNs.
* Recommend procurement of appropriate supplies and equipment according to the operational needs.



**Vendor Management** 



* Ensure the service provider attends to all re\-active service requests from various stakeholders and in compliant with the agreed SLAs.
* Monitor SLAs and KPIs of the outsourced contractors and track performance levels of the contractor providing soft services against set KPIs and SLAs by routinely assessing performance.
* Maintain effective communication with suppliers, business departments and clients and provide active support in the delivery of services by suppliers as per SLAs and QHSE standards.
* Review and certify service provider’s monthly performance and payment certificate.
* Ensures that Service providers use DHAM CAFM systems for all service requests.



**Customer Complaint Management** 



* Ensure customer complaints are timely and appropriately managed and closed to achieve organization’s customer satisfaction targets.
* Ensure that Voice of Customer scores are meeting the minimum required for the FM Department.



**Cross Functional Coordination** 



* Conduct monthly meetings with FM service provider, HSE, security, and contractors to assess the contractor’s performance, HSE requirements, identify non\-compliance and action plans.
* Support the business development team in timely resolution of their queries related to facilities management in coordination with applicable internal departments.
* Manage project’s takeover from asset development and conduct necessary inspection, witness testing \& commissioning and manage rectification of defects and snags during the DLP in coordination with Asset Development Team and contractor.



**Continual Improvement** 



* Identify and recommend to the business unit and department head major improvements (technical and feel \& look) required to enhance the existing facilities.
* Contribute to the process of identifying facilities management best practices and development of formal processes and practices as necessary towards integrating and embedding sustainable principles and strategies into daily operational practices.
* Drive improvement in water and electricity saving and sustainability initiatives.



  





  





 Minimum Qualification:
 



  




* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Facilities Management.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* A professional qualification in real estate and / or facilities management (IWFM) or equivalent is desirable.



 Experience:
 


* Minimum 7\-9 years’ experience in a facilities management related role in a similar organization.



  





 Technical Competencies
 



  




* Demonstrable knowledge of the full spectrum of facilities management functions, including hard and soft services, contract management, tendering, business development etc.
* Maintain a calm demeanor with the ability to remain un\-flustered and maintain a cool head in different situations.
* Excellent negotiation and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with colleagues, contractors and key stakeholders.
* Excellent knowledge of maintenance and operations management.
* Knowledge of Health and Safety standards is advantageous.
* Demonstrate a full understanding of statutory legislation as it relates to the built environment.
* Ability to find pragmatic solutions and adapt to changing situations.
* Excellent communication skills. Arabic is advantageous.

data.raw_snippet: A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, em
data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.jd_text:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. data.jd_text:
**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions


**Responsibilities**
* Expertise in electrical modelling and analysis software (ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, CDEGS, or similar)
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (Navisworks, AutoCAD, single\-line diagram tools)
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks and certifications (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) as they apply to data centres
* Experience with and understanding of the selection of electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities
* Familiarity with industry design standards and specifications (Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ISO standards for data centres)
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) certification preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency strategies, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewable energy integration in data centres
* Experience with utility (DEWA, TAQA, SEC) coordination, power infrastructure planning, and large load interconnection processes with regional utilities
* Knowledge of data centre monitoring and control systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS integration)
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project economics, risk management, and value engineering
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

 Dubai, UAE
   

  

**Reports To**
 Chief Executive Officer
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Head of Production is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end production of the Academy's content, programs, campaigns, events, and multimedia initiatives. The role will oversee production planning, creative execution, studio operations, filming, post\-production, and content delivery to ensure all outputs align with the Academy's mission of empowering entrepreneurs, innovators, creators, and future leaders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Leadership**
* Develop and implement the Academy's production strategy and annual production roadmap
* Lead all production activities across video, podcast, social media, digital learning, events, and branded content
* Establish and maintain production standards, workflows, and quality control processes
* Ensure efficient resource planning and production scheduling


**Content \& Program Production**
* Oversee the production of educational content, masterclasses, interviews, podcasts, documentaries, success stories, and promotional campaigns
* Manage studio, field, and event productions from concept to final delivery
* Ensure all content reflects the Academy's brand identity and strategic objectives
* Support the production of entrepreneurship, innovation, and future economy\-focused programs


**Team Management**
* Lead and manage producers, videographers, editors, motion graphic designers, photographers, and freelancers
* Set objectives, KPIs, and performance standards for the production team
* Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members


**Project \& Budget Management**
* Manage multiple production projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met
* Develop and monitor production budgets and resource allocation
* Ensure cost\-effective production practices without compromising quality
* Track production performance and prepare regular management reports


**Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with internal departments including Programs, Marketing, Partnerships, and Operations
* Coordinate with speakers, entrepreneurs, industry experts, government entities, and external vendors
* Manage relationships with production agencies, freelancers, and service providers


**Event Production**
* Oversee technical and production requirements for events, workshops, boot camps, forums, and conferences
* Ensure seamless execution of live, hybrid, and virtual productions
* Manage livestreaming, stage production, and event content capture


**Innovation \& Technology**
* Introduce new production technologies and AI\-powered tools to improve efficiency and creativity
* Stay updated on industry trends, digital platforms, and content consumption behaviors
* Drive continuous improvement in production processes and audience engagement


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree in Media Production, Film, Communications, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in content production, media, broadcasting, or digital content.
* Minimum 4\-5 years of experience managing production teams.
* Experience producing educational, entrepreneurial, business, or innovation\-related content is highly preferred.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Advanced knowledge of video production, post\-production, and content creation workflows.
* Experience managing studios, podcasts, events, and digital productions.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Strong budgeting and vendor management capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Arabic and English proficiency preferred.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* On\-time project delivery.
* Production quality and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Budget adherence and cost efficiency.
* Team productivity and utilization.
* Content engagement and performance metrics.
* Successful execution of Academy events and programs.
* Innovation and process improvement initiatives.


 This version is aligned with New Economy Academy's focus on entrepreneurship, innovation, future skills, startups, creators, and knowledge\-sharing rather than traditional corporate or media production.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

 .

You will have an acute “own it” mindset, equally obsessed with the experience of individual users as with iterating and optimizing scalable growth tactics and processes.
   

  

 You will have P\&L ownership, delivering the growth and profitability targets for the East Africa market.  Partnerships \& Stakeholder Engagement

* Own growth tactics across sending countries: customer acquisition and retention, pricing, user research, product quality, and customer experience

* Advanced stakeholder management capability
* Experience building, developing, managing and leading teams multi\-regionally.
* Understanding of the regulatory landscape of East Africa (financial regulation is advantageous)

* 7 to 15 years experience in a fast paced and high growth\-environment such as startups, operations, consulting, finance, or similar
* An acute “own it” mindset, equally obsessed with the experience of individual users as with iterating and optimizing scalable growth tactics and processes


**Also you are**
* Outgoing \- you love speaking to people and enjoy building meaningful relationships
* Execution Oriented \- we have an ‘impact first’ philosophy and a lot to get done. You should be able to take an idea to implementation
* Mission Oriented \- you are passionate about working for a net positive organisation / tech for good
* Organised \- you have a system for how you approach your work that can keep you on track in a scrappy startup environment

 Taptap Values
   

  

 Impact first
   

  

 Team next
   

  

 Accept reality
   

  

 Propose solutions
   

  

 Win with grit

 Love the particular

 Create positive energy

All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. data.jd_text:
Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy\-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.
   

  

 The
 **Segment Strategy \& Offer Management Leader** 
 plays a pivotal role in driving the commercial success of Eaton’s systems portfolio within the Data Center segment. The incumbent combines strategic segment leadership with hands\-on offer management to ensure a clear and cohesive link between market needs, segment strategy, and portfolio execution. The Segment Strategy \& Offer Management Leader owns the strategy planning process (SP) for the Data Center segment, leading to the identification, prioritization, and reporting of strategic initiatives that align with the segment’s long\-term growth objectives. At the same time, the role is responsible for the definition, positioning, and evolution of Eaton’s offer portfolio for the segment — including identifying sub\-segments, defining the ideal offer for each, uncovering product and system gaps, and tracking remedation plans. These two responsibilities are tightly integrated, ensuring that strategic planning process directly informs offer development and that Eaton’s market leadership is driven by a systems portfolio that reflects evolving account needs and segment dynamics.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Segment Strategy
* Keep up to date with market dynamics and gather VOC (Voice of Customer) insights from end users, consultants, and channel partners to identify key trends, customer pain points, and emerging opportunities.
* Lead the Strategy Planning (SP) process for the segment and develop metrics and scorecards to ensure ability to track plan performance
* Define and update the segmentation and growth strategy for the Data center segment, including sub\-segments, verticals, and priority markets.
* Map sub\-segment ecosystems and value chains; identify stakeholders and define system's value propositions
* Lead cross\-functional alignment and represent Eaton for positioning as a thought (segment) leader in sustainability, digitalization, and power management.
* Offer Management
* Work with PLMs to define and execute the Offer roadmap, ensuring end\-to\-end management from concept to commercialization.
* Lead Offer design, business case preparation, pricing and ROI analysis, and market launch planning in conjunction with regional marketing teams and alignment with global segment direction.
* Business Development and Commercialization
* Owns development of system sales enablement tools, battle cards, and value propositions.
* Drive alignment between PLMs, marketing, and regional sales teams to ensure commercial execution and measurable growth outcomes.
* Marketing and Demand Generation
* Partner with Segment Marketing and MarCom teams to develop and execute targeted campaigns (including ABM) aligned with segment and Offer priorities.
* Partnership and Ecosystem Development
* Build and nurture strategic partnerships across internal functions and external stakeholders to accelerate Offer adoption and market reach.
* Develop and execute partnership and channel strategies to close go\-to\-market (GTM) gaps and create joint value propositions.
* Stakeholder and Performance Management
* Align multiple stakeholders (Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance) to execute defined strategies and deliver measurable results.
* Monitor business performance versus SP and PP targets and recommend corrective actions where needed.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15 years of experience in Offer Management, Business Development, or Segment Strategy roles.
* Master degree/diploma in Engineering, preferably Electrical Engineering or technical related field \- or business degree with relatable experience
* Proven success in strategy planning, Offer management and systems commercialization in the DC segment.
* Experience with outcome\-based business models preferred.
* Fluent in English.


**Skills**
* Deep knowledge of all the critical power and white space systems.

* Knowledge of Offer lifecycle management, value\-based pricing, and GTM frameworks.

* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate insights into actionable business outcomes.
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills across global and virtual teams.
* High business acumen with data\-driven decision\-making approach.
* Proactive, innovative, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.

data.jd_text:
**Scope**
 The Asset Director will play a key strategic role within Skyways Technics, as part of the company’s senior management team, overseeing the full lifecycle management of high\-value assets such as aircraft, engines and landing gears. Reporting directly to the VP Assets, this position is responsible for defining, executing, and continuously optimizing the company’s asset strategy to ensure alignment with market demand, commercial objectives, and long\-term profitability.
   

  

 The role combines strategic asset portfolio management, high\-level commercial decision\-making, and global business development. The Asset Director will actively identify acquisition opportunities, evaluate technical and financial risks, and structure transactions that maximize asset value.
   

  

 Acting as a senior commercial leader, the Asset Director will maintain direct relationships with key customers, prospects, and partners worldwide, while providing transversal leadership to international sales teams. The role requires continuous engagement with the global aviation aftermarket through trade fairs, industry events, and ongoing networking, ensuring Skyways Technics remains well\-positioned to anticipate market trends and seize emerging opportunities.
   

  

 In addition to commercial and strategic responsibilities, the Asset Management Director will ensure rigorous documentation and compliance standards across all assets, including comprehensive traceability and maintenance history reviews. Regular reporting to senior management will support informed decision\-making at executive level, with clear visibility on asset performance, market conditions, risks, and profitability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the company’s asset portfolio to ensure alignment with market needs and commercial strategy.
* Control and optimize total inventory value with a strong focus on profitability and cash flow.
* Lead the asset acquisition team responsible to identify, evaluate, and acquire second\-hand aircraft (ATR, A320, B737\) or airframe. Including the negotiation of the most favorable commercial terms with potential sellers (lessors, airlines etc.), from LOI draft review to execution of the SPA.
* Source and acquire landing gears and engines available on the global market.
* Oversee documentation reviews, including but not limited to Back\-to\-Birth traceability and shop visit history.
* Sell, Lease, Exchange landing gears and engines to existing customers and new prospects.
* Maintain direct commercial relationships with customers and key accounts.
* Leverage and expand an existing network within the commercial aviation aftermarket.
* Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships while identifying new partners.
* Prepare business cases and cash flow scenarios for asset acquisitions and projects.
* Monitor and report on the profitability and performance of projects and assets.
* Provide transversal leadership and coordination of global sales teams.
* Act as a senior commercial leader, driving collaboration and priorities across region and manage the sale \& lease of assets directly or indirectly (using the local sales teams).
* Report regularly to higher management on asset performance, market trends, and opportunities.
* Represent Skyways Technics at trade fairs, industry events, and conferences.
* Conduct continuous market intelligence and networking to identify opportunities and trends.
* Provide regular sales forecasts, reports, and insights to senior management to inform strategic decision\-making.
* Participate in the company’s senior management meetings (online and in person).
* Travel regularly to visit customers and stakeholders (average of 20% travel time expected)


**Skills \& Added Qualification Requirements**
* Fluent in English speaking, reading, and writing
* Experienced in Narrowbody \& ATR aircraft, engines and landing gears
* Meticulous, organized and accurate
* Effective communication
* Strong interpersonal skills, self\-motivated and performance driven
* Curious, willing to take calculated risks
* Multi\-tasker, Hands on and Team Player
* Experience in selling B2B services, especially for repairing and selling aircraft components
* An existing network of customers in commercial aviation aftermarket sector

data.jd_text:
**About j. awan \& partners** 




  





 At j. awan \& partners, we believe in “challenging the status quo every day”, delivering seamless excellence to our customers across the world. We challenge the status quo by making tailor\-made solutions to meet the specific requirements of our clients’ business interests and delivering our solutions to their needs with effective simplicity. We understand that time is precious and as
 



 such our tailor\-made solutions are simple to understand, simple to embed and simple to use.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing international Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultancy with our headquarters in the Dubai International Finance Centre (DIFC). We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.
 



  





**Mission / Purpose of the Role** 




  





 The Senior Manager – Compliance role will lead and oversee regulatory compliance and AML/CTF obligations across a portfolio of client mandates within the Region. The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. This position plays a critical role in safeguarding regulatory integrity, strengthening client trust, and elevating JAP’s compliance standards across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





**12 – 18 Month Mission Outcomes** 




**Mission / Outcome** 




  





**Act as a trusted outsourced Compliance Officer and MLRO.** 



* Timely execution of compliance deliverables; clients’ regulatory obligations consistently met.
* Effective communication with Regulators.



  





**Deliver high\-quality Regulatory Compliance and AML services to clients.** 



* Applications submitted on schedule; licences obtained with minimal Regulator queries or rejections. Positive client feedback. No material regulatory breaches or audit findings.



  





**Develop and implement robust Compliance and AML frameworks and training programs.** 



* Policies aligned with regulatory requirements; regular AML and Compliance training conducted, resulting in improved compliance awareness among clients.



  





**Audit, monitor, and improve compliance processes.** 



* Regular compliance reviews completed; identified gaps addressed with corrective action; internal controls strengthened.



  





**Manage and expand the compliance client portfolio while supporting business growth across the Region.** 



* New business opportunities identified and supported. Strengthened client retention and satisfaction. Growth in brand visibility and market presence.



  





**Continuously improve compliance and AML/CTF systems.** 



* Implementation of new processes, tools, or automation; measurable reduction in compliance risks; adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Strengthen business development and client engagement.** 



* New client acquisitions; increased market share and revenue from compliance services; successful representation at industry events.



  





**Contribute to firm culture, brand, and people development.** 



* Positive internal and external stakeholder feedback. Support in recruitment and retention initiatives. Active mentorship and knowledge sharing within the team.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Regulatory Compliance Delivery** 



* Provide ongoing compliance and AML support to clients.
* Draft, implement, and manage compliance and AML frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.



  





**Audit \& Monitoring** 



* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.
* Strengthened internal controls.



  





**Training \& Awareness** 



* Deliver training on compliance, AML, and governance topics.
* Build client awareness of emerging regulations and risks.
* Client confirmation of effective and timely training delivery.
* Full client participation with positive feedback.
* Relevant regulatory updates delivered to clients.



  





**Business Development \& Brand Representation** 



* Support senior team in executing client mandates.
* Help with origination of new business.
* Represent the Firm at industry and promotional events.
* Positive feedback from senior team.
* New business opportunities identified and supported.
* Active participation in events.



  





**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Communicate compliance risks and obligations to senior management.
* Foster relationships with stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and clients.
* Represent consultancy professionally.
* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.
* Refine compliance/AML systems, processes, and training.
* Implement best practices.
* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Team \& Culture** 



* Promote j. awan \& partners’ culture and brand.
* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.
* Operational Excellence: Experienced in executing compliance and AML programs efficiently, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to deadlines across multiple client mandates.
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills: Exceptional capability to analyse complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and translate them into actionable, fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Integrity \& Accountability: Upholds the highest professional and ethical standards, maintains confidentiality, and demonstrates reliability and accountability in all activities.
* Stakeholder Management \& Cultural Agility: Skilled at building partnerships and influencing clients, regulators, and internal teams, with the adaptability to work effectively across diverse organisations and cultural contexts.



  





**Role\-Specific Competencies** 



* Compliance \& AML Expertise: Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and overseeing regulatory compliance and AML frameworks within financial services, with proven ability to manage obligations across applicable regulatory regimes including but not limited to DFSA, ADGM, QFCRA, FCA, and CMA.
* KYC \& Regulatory Delivery: Proven KYC and due diligence capability including risk classification and SLA\-driven delivery, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, fit\-for\-purpose policies and procedures.
* Organisation \& Execution: Strong ability to manage multiple compliance projects and competing deadlines simultaneously, working independently under pressure while maintaining accuracy and quality of delivery.
* Stakeholder \& Communication Skills: Exceptional oral and written communication skills for effective interaction with clients, regulators, and senior leadership, with strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain productive working relationships.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or Accountancy.



  





**Experience** 



* Significant demonstrable experience in dealing with regulatory authorities within the Region.
* Minimum 8 years overall industry experience, with at least 4 years in Compliance roles within Financial Services.
* Direct experience in developing and implementing compliance programs is essential.
* Direct experience in creating and implementing regulatory compliance programs within a successful financial services organisation.



  





**Additional Requirements** 



* CAMS, CISI, or ICA qualifications preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

**Medical Devices**
 Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.

 We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life\-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better\-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.
   

  

 Abbott Diabetes Care (ADC) Division is looking for a Market Access Manager\-Gulf region based in UAE

* Position will own the responsibility to achieve market access and reimbursement for new ADC products (formulary listening, coding, coverage \& pricing.)
* Position will establish and leverage critical relationships to key market access stakeholders, developing customer intimacy and aiming for mutually beneficially partnership opportunities.
* Position reports to the Country Manager and will interact with the Business Unit Heads in the targeted countries for this position, the relevant team members in those countries and global market access team.

* Ensures that all activities are performed in compliance with quality system requirements.
* Accelerate hospital enlisting after\-market authorization.
* Maintain active intelligence of pricing trends and reimbursement/funding in region in order to anticipate risks and opportunities for ADC portfolio.
* There must be insight into payers' decision\-making, the processes and criteria they use, and the skills to use these insights.
* Building a strong partnership with KO Ls in the field of diabetes across gulf.
* Support public affairs and reimbursement.
* Establish and leverage critical relationships to key market access stakeholders, developing customer intimacy and aiming for mutually beneficial partnership opportunities.
* Define strategic actions to the changing market environment finding innovative solutions to defending ADC's products in the market.
* Support the Commercial Department in developing strategies to maximize in­market performance.
* Create a Payer Strategy and engagement covering market access and product differentiation.

* Work closely with the Market Access Director and the ADC Management team to deliver and support all strategic goals.
* Identify areas where the Mega opportunities for product growth lie.
* Clarifies key stakeholders' product specific value propositions.
* Match pricing target with key stakeholders' value propositions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Required : Advanced Degree in Science, Economics or related areas.
* Preferred : Master's Degree in Business Administration, Public Health, Health Economics, or Health policy.


**Background**
* Broad knowledge of the Countries' reimbursement systems.
* Robust understanding of national reimbursement authorities including localized decisions and the ongoing changes that could affect the commercial goals.
* Demonstrable track record in working with KOLs/reimbursement stakeholders in influencing product guidelines, removing barriers to ensure products are used in key centers.
* Market Access experience preferably within Medical Devices/Pharma sector.
* Tender Management experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence relationships and leverage knowledge internally across a matrix structure to optimize opportunities with customers and achieve shared goals.
* Ability to influence internally at all levels without line management authority.
* Ability to influence external customers at all levels.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* IT literate.


**Impact of position**
* Identify emerging business opportunities.
* Sales/ profit targets.
* Success in particular assigned projects.
* Win particular accounts.


 Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that provides the growth and strength to build your future. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
   

  

 Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott\-/, on Facebook at http ://www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

 . Lead the City Technology Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for portfolio governance, delivery assurance, demand intake, stage\-gate control, and operational readiness across all IT and OT technology towers within QIC City Technology.
   

  

 This role ensures that City Technology programs and vendors deliver technology solutions in a controlled, auditable manner, and that all deliverables meet defined governance requirements for readiness, documentation, cybersecurity gating, and transition into
 **technology L2/L3 support** 
 .
   

  

 The PMO acts as the control tower for all City Technology projects transitioning into run\-state operations.
   

  

**Reporting Line**
 Reports to:
 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**
**Direct Reports:** 
 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts
   

  

**Role Scope (City Technology Only)**
**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)
* City OT \& Smart Systems technology
* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls
* Integrated Program Controls
* Maintain an integrated view of City Technology delivery progress across towers and suppliers
* Track delivery milestones, critical path items, and cross\-tower dependencies
* Identify schedule slippage, scope creep, and delivery risk early and escalate through governance forums
* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)
* Govern and enforce delivery stage gates, including:
* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support
* Ensure no system progresses through gates without evidence and sign\-offs


**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)
* Own RAID governance standards across all City Technology delivery programs
* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers
* Vendor Delivery \& Handover Governance Support (non\-commercial)
* Ensure vendors comply with City Technology Delivery \& Handover Governance requirements:
+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

* Provide delivery performance evidence to:
+ Commercials/Vendor Management function (for contract governance)
+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

* Alignment to Governance, Architecture, and Cybersecurity
* Ensure delivery programs comply with:
+ corporate technology governance processes (where applicable)
+ City Technology governance and architecture standards
+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements
+ Track and report exceptions and required waivers through the correct forums


**Key Interfaces**
**Internal:**
* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function
* Director — City Technology Operations (City) (for transition readiness alignment only)
* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**
* Define acceptance criteria for transition from Project to Operations
* Ensure support documentation, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs and vendor contracts are in place
* Validate security hardening and compliance sign\-offs
* Coordinate CAB approvals and go\-live governance
* Confirm training and knowledge transfer completion


**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**
* Track total technology investment portfolio (CAPEX and transformation OPEX)
* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**
* Engage Directors across all City Technology tower
* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required
* Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification preferred
* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

 نتطلع للتعرف عليك وتلقي طلبك!
 




  





**📍 مكان العمل: جدة** 




 نبحث عن مشرف تأجير يتمتع بخبرة عملية في إدارة عمليات التأجير والإشراف على الفروع، لضمان تطبيق السياسات والإجراءات التشغيلية، وتحقيق مستهدفات الأداء، وتعزيز تجربة العملاء.
 



 نبحث عن مرشح يمتلك خبرة عملية في قطاع تأجير السيارات للإشراف على عمليات التأجير بالفروع والتطبيقات، وقيادة فرق العمل، ومتابعة العقود والتحصيل، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة والإجراءات التشغيلية وتحقيق أعلى مستويات الخدمة.
 



**المهام الرئيسية:** 



* الإشراف على عمليات التأجير بالفروع والتطبيقات ومتابعة سير العمل اليومي.
* إدارة ومتابعة العقود المفتوحة والمعلقة والمغلقة والتأكد من استكمال الإجراءات النظامية.
* متابعة التحصيل والعملاء المتأخرين والمتعثرين واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية.
* الإشراف على موظفي الفروع ومنسقي التطبيقات والسائقين ومتابعة أدائهم وانضباطهم.
* مراجعة يوميات الفروع والصندوق والتأكد من سلامة الإجراءات المالية.
* متابعة جاهزية الأسطول والتنسيق مع إدارات التشغيل والأسطول والصيانة.
* متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على سرعة معالجتها وتحسين تجربة العميل.
* التأكد من التزام الفروع بلوائح وأنظمة نشاط تأجير السيارات ومتطلبات الجهات التنظيمية.
* إعداد التقارير التشغيلية ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء ورفع التوصيات التطويرية.



**المؤهلات والمتطلبات:** 



* الجنسية سعودية
* خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال تأجير السيارات أو التشغيل.
* معرفة جيدة بأنظمة ولوائح نشاط تأجير السيارات.
* مهارات قيادية وإدارية وقدرة على إدارة فرق العمل.
* مهارات عالية في المتابعة والتحليل وإعداد التقارير.
* إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي والأنظمة التشغيلية ذات العلاقة.



**المزايا** 



* بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة.
* فرص للتطوير الوظيفي والنمو المهني.
* راتب ومزايا تنافسية حسب الخبرة والكفاءة.
