data.jd_text:
**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.
* Provide on monthly basis with a safety statistic report for the individual’s entire operation.
* Liaise with the Client on all matters related to Safety.
* Conduct safety meetings with all the department heads and establish a safety committee to closely monitor and update management on safety matters.
* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
* The individual is fully responsible and accountable for the HSE policies and procedures, which are in place.

data.jd_text:
👋 Thanks for taking the time to learn more about this role at 9H!
 



  





 Managing Director \- Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
 



  





 Location: Riyadh, KSA (in\-Kingdom) ·
 



 Reports to: Board · Experience: 10\+ years ·
 



 Mandate: P\&L, commercial and delivery ·
 



 Start: ASAP, before October
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 TAYB a tech\-led strategic partner spanning brand \& reach, technology \& solutions, and AI \& automation. 
 



 We are moving from a single executive commercial channel to a durable structure with one accountable owner in\-region. This is that role. The Managing Director takes ownership of the Gulf P\&L as our founding partner transitions to a non\-executive board seat — inheriting strong key accounts, and given the engine to win new ones.
 



  





 The role — run the A–Z of the venture
 



 A full general\-management mandate with a commercial heart. The MD owns the number, the clients, and the team that delivers for them.
 


* Own the Gulf P\&L: full accountability for revenue, margin and the cost base of the KSA venture.
* Protect and grow key accounts: take personal handover of existing strategic relationships, become the trusted senior point of contact, and drive retention and upsell.
* Drive the new\-logo pipeline: own origination and conversion personally, and build it as a repeatable engine rather than a series of one\-off wins.
* Build and run the commercial layer: manage a performance\-led network of senior Gulf rainmakers plus internal commercial colleagues — qualification standards, pipeline discipline, and the 90\-day performance gates.
* Orchestrate delivery: direct on\-ground account leads and the Egypt delivery team, with a structured KSA travel cadence, so delivery quality matches the relationship.
* Represent TAYB at the top of the room: C\-suite, family offices, ministerial and semi\-government settings, and navigate Etimad, procurement frameworks and approved\-vendor ecosystems.
* Be the board's eyes in the Kingdom: honest reporting on pipeline, cash and market, flagging the accelerate\-or\-hold calls early.



  





 Who you are — essential
 


* 10\+ years' experience in senior commercial or general\-management roles, with a clear track record of carrying and hitting a number.
* From a similar business — agency, digital, technology, consulting or professional services — with a real understanding of how this model makes money and how it delivers.
* End\-to\-end capability: comfortable running the whole venture — commercial, delivery oversight, team, and the P\&L behind it.
* Strong Gulf network: real, current senior relationships across KSA and the wider Gulf that can be activated from day one.
* Based in Riyadh, in\-Kingdom, and able to travel the Gulf as the business requires.



  





 Who you are — strongly preferred
 


* KSA market fluency: first\-hand experience of Vision 2030 programmes, government and semi\-government buying, and Etimad / vendor frameworks.
* Arabic and English: professional working proficiency in both; Arabic a strong advantage for senior relationship\-building.
* Builder's mindset: has stood up or scaled a market, function or office — not only managed a mature one.
* People leadership: experience leading distributed teams across borders and time zones.
* Cash\-aware: manages growth against the cash position, not in spite of it.



  





 How you work
 



 Commercially relentless · owner, not passenger · relationship\-led · hands\-on · straight with the board · calm under pace · across both detail and the big picture.
 



  





 What success looks like
 


* 100% of key accounts retained through the transition.
* A single accountable owner of the Gulf P\&L (the A–Z of the venture).
* A repeatable new\-logo engine, not one\-off wins.



  





 What we offer
 


* A market with proven demand: real revenue, signed logos, and a credible base to build from — not a standing start.
* Genuine ownership: the autonomy of a founding GM with the backing of an established group and board.
* A performance\-led commercial engine: a rainmaker network and delivery teams ready to run behind the MD.
* Competitive package: senior base plus performance\-linked upside, structured for a commercially focused leader.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Commercial Director for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait is responsible for shaping and executing a long‑term (3–5 year) commercial strategy with a strong focus on accelerating growth in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—one of Hilton’s most strategically important markets, expected to exceed 100 hotels within five years.
   

  

 This role leads the development of the value proposition and investment cases required to unlock this growth, ensuring the right commercial foundations are established across Sales, Marketing, Distribution, and Revenue functions. The appointee will assess organizational design needs, budget requirements, talent capabilities, and performance enablers needed for sustained market leadership.
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is accountable for delivering top‑tier commercial performance across the three markets and driving market share growth. The role includes hiring, developing, and mentoring high‑potential talent, ensuring alignment with Hilton’s strategic priorities while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton’s values.
   

  

 A critical success factor is the ability to build strong, influential partnerships with senior commercial leaders, regional and brand teams, GMs, ownership groups, and cross‑functional stakeholders. The role requires exceptional communication, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking to solve complex business challenges and enable sustained success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Business Acumen**
* Partner with the VP Commercial Services and Commercial Director MEA to develop long‑term regional strategy, business cases, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as the commercial business partner to the VP Operations for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Director, enabling them to own near‑term tactical execution.
* Support new hotel openings from a commercial perspective, leveraging Hilton’s full commercial engine (RMCC, HWS, shared sales offices, Marketing, F\&B, HRCC).
* Translate organizational goals into clear performance standards for the Commercial Services team.


**Setting Strategy**
* Develop medium‑ and long‑term commercial strategies to drive sustained, above‑market revenue performance across all three markets.
* Clearly communicate strategic priorities, progress, and results to internal and external stakeholders.
* Gain senior‑level alignment and sponsorship for key initiatives required to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Lead strategic planning within the Commercial Services team to advance enterprise goals and ensure consistent communication.


**Executing for Results**
* Lead negotiations with third‑party partners and suppliers as required.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Revenue, Sales, F\&B, Marketing, eCommerce, and Finance teams, as well as commercial leadership across MEA and EMEA.
* Ensure all commercial initiatives are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Drive integrated commercial action across functions to maximize RevPAR and market share.


**Leading Teams**
* Ensure Commercial Services teams provide strong support to on‑property commercial teams.
* Build and maintain a high‑performing talent pipeline, developing future leaders and succession plans.
* Create a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Building Relationships and Influencing**
* Develop strong relationships across senior leadership to enable alignment and collaboration.
* Strengthen partnerships with MEA and EMEA commercial teams to elevate commercial performance.
* Maintain effective coordination with global commercial functions, including Database Management, HRCC, Distribution, and Channel Management.
* Represent the commercial function at property visits, corporate meetings, owner meetings, and business reviews.


**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
* Demonstrated experience operating at a regional level with responsibility for a portfolio of no fewer than 20 hotels, including oversight of commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic execution across multiple countries. Proven track record in high‑growth markets, ideally with exposure to environments experiencing 4x\+ growth rates, where rapid scaling, agility, and commercial innovation are essential.
* Strong relationship building skills
* Ability to effectively plan and proactively communicate/manage expectations with stakeholders that may include both internal and external partners (project sponsors/ senior leadership team)
* Experience in working in a matrix organization
* Experience in Revenue Management, Sales \& Marketing
* Presents clear and logical arguments and decision based on factual data.
* Quick and accurate when evaluating complex written and numerical information.
* Develops constructive relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrates leadership and effectively motivates teams, helps others when needed.
* Maintains effectiveness in situations of disappointment or high pressure.
* Adapts willingly to change.
* Identifies priorities effectively, balancing importance, urgency and resources.
* Manages own personal time efficiently within tight schedules.
* Strategic thinker while translating financial goals into operational plans
* Previous experience in Change management and organisational design.
* Storytelling and ability to create, business cases, presentations to gain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Dynamic, innovative, and creative in finding business solutions
* Works effectively and accurately in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to challenge while maintaining strong relationships
* A high level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills with the ability to provide and receive professional, constructive feedback that elevates individual performance and job satisfaction


**About The Team**
**How We’ll Help You Thrive**
**Benefits**
 At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
   

  

 Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
   

  

 Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
   

  

 Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
   

  

 Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   

  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

 TikTok LIVE connects creators and communities in real time, enabling interactive experiences and new monetisation opportunities. As part of TikTok’s regional management and support function, the Regional Headquarters is seeking a Regional Agency Strategy, Governance and Enablement Manager to support TikTok group entities across the MENAT region. The role will support the development of regional agency\-management strategy, training, performance analytics, policy implementation and operational governance, with local execution undertaken by the relevant operating entities.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Develop, maintain and support implementation of regional agency\-management policies, playbooks, onboarding standards and governance processes for TikTok LIVE across the MENA/MENAT region.
   

 2\. Support local operating entities in identifying, assessing and managing MCNs, agencies and creator organisations in accordance with approved regional standards, without directly contracting on behalf of the RHQ entity.
   

 3\. Design and deliver regional training materials and enablement programmes for internal teams on agency\-management processes, platform policies, compliance requirements and operational best practices.
   

 4\. Analyse regional agency performance data and provide recommendations to local operating entities and regional leadership on agency quality, category development and creator ecosystem trends.
   

 5\. Coordinate with product, policy, legal, compliance and local operations teams to improve regional agency\-management methodology and ensure consistent application of TikTok LIVE standards.
   

 6\. Contribute to regional business planning, operational governance and performance reporting for the LIVE creator agency ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

 \- Bachelor's degree or above.
   

 \- Deep passion for TikTok, mobile entertainment, social media, and popular culture.
   

 \- Experience in the live\-streaming industry and understanding of latest live\-streaming trends.
   

 \- Experience in regional strategy, business operations, governance, analytics, partner enablement or cross\-functional programme management within a technology, media, entertainment, social media or creator economy business.
   

  

 This role is based in the Company’s KSA Regional Headquarters and is responsible for providing regional strategy, management, governance, analytics, training and coordination support to Company group entities across the MENAT/MENA region. The role does not involve direct sales to customers, direct contracting with creators, agencies or users on behalf of the RHQ entity, or direct operation of local commercial activities.  TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Project Portfolio Management (PPM) Senior Manager is responsible for leading and institutionalizing enterprise\-wide portfolio management practices, ensuring all initiatives are strategically aligned, financially governed, and executed with full transparency.
   

  

 This role acts as a critical bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into a governed, optimized, and value\-driven portfolio of initiatives. It will drive the transformation from fragmented project execution into a structured, data\-driven portfolio model, addressing key challenges such as inconsistent demand intake, lack of project classification, limited financial visibility, and weak governance enforcement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Planning, Direction \& Alignment
* Partner with executive leadership to support the development and refinement of organizational strategy
* Ensure clear linkage between strategy, initiatives, and measurable business outcomes
* Establish mechanisms to continuously align portfolio execution with evolving strategic priorities
* Lead strategic planning cycles from a portfolio perspective (initiative shaping, sequencing, and dependencies)
* Define and govern strategic KPIs and value realization frameworks across the portfolio
* Portfolio Strategy \& Governance
* Define and lead the enterprise\-wide PPM framework, standards, and operating model
* Translate strategic objectives into a structured and governed project portfolio
* Establish portfolio segmentation (e.g., strategic, regulatory, operational, innovation)
* Ensure alignment between portfolio investments and organizational strategy
* Demand Management \& Intake Control
* Design and enforce a centralized demand intake and approval process
* Institutionalize project classification standards (project vs. BAU vs. enhancement)
* Ensure all requests are captured through a unified platform (eliminating shadow processes)
* Ensure all initiatives are uniquely identified and tracked
* Portfolio Prioritization \& Optimization
* Establish and govern a standardized prioritization model (value, cost, risk, dependencies)
* Lead portfolio planning cycles and continuous reprioritization
* Optimize resource allocation across competing initiatives
* Manage trade\-offs and scenario analysis at portfolio level
* Financial Governance \& Value Realization
* Own portfolio\-level financial oversight, including budget alignment and tracking
* Ensure project\-level budget visibility and linkage to financial systems
* Monitor financial performance (actuals vs. forecast vs. approved budgets)
* Drive benefits realization tracking and value measurement
* Governance \& Performance Management
* Define and enforce portfolio governance frameworks, stage gates, and approval workflows
* Define portfolio KPIs, SLAs, and performance metrics
* Establish executive\-level dashboards and reporting standards
* Provide actionable insights on portfolio health, risks, and dependencies
* Escalate and manage underperforming or at\-risk initiatives
* Tools, Data \& Systems Integration
* Lead the implementation and governance of PPM tools and platforms
* Ensure integration across systems (e.g., Jira, ERP, procurement systems)
* Eliminate duplication and enforce a single source of truth
* Standardize project structures (WBS, PO linkage, renewals, etc.)
* Reporting \& Executive Insights
* Provide executive dashboards and portfolio insights (status, risks, financials, dependencies)
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through accurate and timely reporting
* Communicate portfolio health to senior leadership
* Continuous Improvement \& Maturity Development
* Assess current maturity and define a PPM maturity roadmap
* Benchmark against best practices (e.g., PMI (Project Management Institute), Axelos)
* Continuously refine governance, processes, and performance frameworks
* Lead transformation initiatives to enhance portfolio effectiveness


**Qualifications**
**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Master's degree or MBA with a technology management or digital strategy focus (preferred).


**Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of experience in Project, Program, or Portfolio Management
* Proven experience in establishing or transforming PPM functions at enterprise level
* Demonstrated experience developing or contributing to digital transformation strategies and multi\-year technology roadmaps.
* Proven track record of designing and running portfolio prioritization frameworks in organizations with competing demands and resource constraints.
* Experience in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Strong exposure to financial governance, budgeting, and investment planning
* Experience leading a team or function; not just managing projects, but managing people and building a practice


 Certifications
   

  

* PMP — Project Management Professional, PMI or equivalent (required).
* PMI\-PfMP — Portfolio Management Professional, or PgMP — Program Management Professional (highly preferred; demonstrated willingness to certify is acceptable).


 Leadership \& Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic thinker; able to hold the long\-term direction and the immediate decision simultaneously, without losing sight of either
* Influential communicator; builds alignment across peers, teams, and leadership through clarity, credibility, and consistency.
* Strong governance design and enforcement capability
* Advanced financial and analytical skills
* Decision\-making under ambiguity
* Transformation and change leadership
* Structured problem\-solving.


**LI\-DNP**

* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.

* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.

* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.

* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.

**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.

* Programme and risk management

* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.

**The Opportunity**

The Services function ensures success by engaging with customers in the pre\-sales and post\-sales stages by assisting in their software\-defined data center (SDDC) strategy and architecture. Besides helping customers implement Nutanix products successfully, the Professional Services team, working with our partners, ensures customer success in fully implementing their virtualized and software\-defined data centers. * Partner with architects and resourcing teams to strategically schedule and deploy internal and external consulting talent.
* Proactively anticipate budget or timeline challenges, and deliver accurate quarterly revenue forecasting within internal systems of record.
* Collaborate with global Project Managers to optimize PM methodologies, share best practices, and continuously improve team efficiency.
* Create and maintain comprehensive, audit\-ready program documentation and execution frameworks.


**What You Will Bring**

* Broad experience with managing complex projects of a variety of hardware, software, infrastructure, and cloud platforms and platform integrations
* Exceptional organizational skills including ability to plan, attention to detail, facilitation, time management, leadership and multi\- tasking skills
* Ability to work with clients and stakeholders to identify business objectives and align program deliverables to them· Ability to align the deliverables (outputs) to the program's outcome.
* Understanding of large\-scale customer operational standards and processes, preferably in the Banking/FSI sector.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English \& Arabic.
* Proven ability to problem solve and be dynamic in complex situations
* Self starter with intense drive for improvement and delivering results
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project planning tools
* Proficient with Agile project management
* Experience using change management processes for dynamic professional services projects

* PMP required, PgMP, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) a plus

 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. **Job Title** 
 : Program Manager (PMO)
   

  

**Employment type** 
 : Contract (On\-site)
   

  

**Contract length** 
 : 6 \- 12 months
   

  

**Location** 
 : Riyadh, KSA
   

  

**PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT**
 We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Program Manager to lead the Debit Diversification Program in Saudi Arabia. This role will sit within our Consulting \& Analytics function and is designed to enhance credit and prepaid card penetration among existing Debit Cardholders by managing a wide range of activities including telesales hiring and supervision, sales training, and performance tracking.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
* Oversee the entire Debit Diversification Program, ensuring timely and successful delivery of all components.
* Recruit, train, and manage a team of 4\-6 telesales agents per bank across seven participating banks to drive incremental outbound sales.
* Implement robust tracking systems to measure the effectiveness of sales activities and overall program impact.
* Develop detailed reports and templates for program updates and stakeholder communication.
* Engage with key stakeholders from leading banks in KSA to facilitate seamless program execution.
* Coordinate with Consulting \& Analytics to schedule and conduct in\-person sales training sessions, enhancing the sales skills of branch and direct sales staff.
* Organize sales competitions and incentive programs to motivate sales teams, ensuring alignment with program objectives.
* Oversee program budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and cost\-effectiveness.


**Knowledge and Experience:**
* 7\+ years of professional experience in program management, preferably within the financial services industry.
* Strong leadership skills with experience in team management and development.
* Excellent analytical skills and experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Proficiency in reporting tools and project management software.
* Fluency in Arabic and English.
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and engagement


**Mandatory Skills:**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Previous experience within Banking, Digital Payment \& Card solutions, or the FinTech industry.
* Regional experience, including working in a faced\-paced matrix organisation.
* Excellent communication skills in English \& Arabic (written, verbal, and presentation).


**Preferred Skills:**
* The ability to analyse data, troubleshoot payment issues, optimize processes, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Good understanding of payment systems, digital platforms, system workflows, security basics, and industry technologies.
* An understanding of regional regulations across financial services or payment networks.

JASARA PMC is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Project Director \- Residential** 
 to lead and manage our residential construction projects with a focus on delivering high\-quality, innovative, and sustainable housing solutions. In this senior role, you will be responsible for overseeing the full project lifecycle from inception to completion, ensuring that all projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet the highest standards.
   

  

 The Senior Project Director will lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with clients and stakeholders, and drive strategic initiatives to optimize project performance. This is an exciting opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about shaping residential communities in line with modern standards and client expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Take ownership of residential project portfolios, managing all aspects including planning, execution, budgeting, and delivery
* Lead, mentor, and develop project teams to enhance productivity and ensure excellence in project delivery
* Collaborate with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to maintain strong relationships and ensure project alignment with strategic objectives
* Create and enforce project management best practices, standards, and controls
* Identify risks and develop mitigation strategies to safeguard project success
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and environmental policies throughout the project lifecycle
* Provide regular project updates and reports to executive leadership and stakeholders


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field. A Master's degree is preferred
* Minimum 20 years of experience in construction project management, with at least 10 years in a senior leadership role in residential projects
* Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering large\-scale residential developments
* Proven leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and guide multidisciplinary teams
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Familiarity with Saudi Arabia's regulatory environment and construction standards is an advantage
* Relevant professional certifications such as PMP or equivalent are highly desirable
* Saudi Nationals are preferred

**Job Description**
 Release your expertise and navigate regulatory landscapes to bring products to life in a global market. Shape your future and ours as you collaborate with teams and bridge products with market demands.
   

  

 The Central, Eastern Europe, Middle East and Africa (CEEMEA) Treasury Services (TS) Team forms part of the Global TS Product team, partnering with global and regional stakeholders to execute on product strategy, development and commercialization of the end to end TS solutions that J.P. Morgan delivers to all clients across its booking locations locally within CEEMEA.
   

  

 As a Market and Product Expansion Director in Treasury Services and Payments, you serve as the subject matter expert on market requirements and are the point of contact for regulators. You will shape and execute the firm's strategy, develop product capabilities, and expand our footprint in Saudi Arabia. You bring an extensive understanding of the regulatory landscape in different regions and markets to help ensure our products launch and are adopted successfully. This role requires close collaboration with global and regional stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Service, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Legal.
   

  

 You will also serve as Head of Payments, Saudi Arabia, driving the Payments business strategy and acting as the single point of contact for Payments for both the branch and global stakeholders. In partnership with senior colleagues, you will interface directly with the regulator to support business objectives and work closely across functions to deliver on strategic goals.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design product operational activities to fit the market and adapt collateral, sales training, pricing, and request for proposal (RFP) materials to resonate with target segments and local requirements.
* Lead Treasury Services product strategy by leveraging deep knowledge of the KSA payment landscape and client needs.
* Grow our market, bring opportunities to the Product Management team, advocate for expansion, provide input into business cases, and meet business targets.
* Develop compelling business cases through detailed market and revenue analysis, proposing effective solutions.
* Formulate and execute strategies in partnership with Global and Regional Product and Sales Executives, covering Core Cash, Liquidity, Access, FX, and more.
* Maintain an open relationship with market regulators and supervisors, providing insights into regulatory dialogue and developments across the market.
* Partner closely with Product teams to ensure adherence to local regulations, controls frameworks, and governance approval processes.
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Technology, Implementations, and other relevant teams to identify, develop, and launch products.
* Oversee daily operations, maintaining robust sales and risk management discipline (including KYC, financial crime, and reputational risk).
* Drive commercialization and communication plans for new solutions, expanding market footprint and revenue.
* Represent Payments at internal management forums, external industry events, and regulatory bodies.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Proven experience or equivalent expertise in Product, Technology, or Project Management, ideally across multiple disciplines (e.g., Sales, Client Management, Product, Operations, Risk, Legal, Finance).
* Advanced level knowledge of risk management and controls, regional and local nuances, and governance requirements.
* Strong business understanding of Saudi Arabia and the broader CEEMEA region.
* Extensive experience in the payments industry, including building and delivering payment or growth strategies for financial institutions, and a deep understanding of payments and treasury services products.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities for market growth in line with regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated prior experience influencing across functions and teams while delivering value at scale.
* Ability to quickly build strong partnerships, credibility, and influence with technology, functional partners, and senior management.
* Strong leadership and experience in managing and motivating teams from diverse backgrounds and seniority.
* Commercially minded individual with creative problem solving, capable of developing innovative and differentiated solutions.
* Proven ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization and across various stakeholders.
* Profit and loss management experience provides a deep understanding of the challenges within payments businesses across the region.

* Experience working with local regulatory authorities.
* Experience championing the region's people agenda by attracting top talent and fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you the strategic mastermind who can turn complex aviation regulations into a symphony of safety and performance?
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with teams across Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance to embed quality, compliance, and accountability into every aspect of the operation, ensuring the highest standards of safety and performance.
   

  

 Take the lead in establishing, implementing, and continuously enhancing quality management systems and compliance monitoring frameworks that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Drive operational excellence by overseeing audits, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective risk management, audit readiness, and the successful closure of findings across all operational areas.
   

  

 Ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated through robust monitoring, transparent reporting, and corrective action plans that safeguard operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
   

  

 Hold authority to interface with regulatory bodies on compliance\-related matters, including securing approvals, responding to regulatory inquiries, managing certifications such as Third Country Operator (TCO) authorization, and representing the organization during audits and inspections.
   

  

 Lead and develop high\-performing quality and compliance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and operational accountability while ensuring sustainable compliance leadership and decision\-making continuity.
   

  

 Drive a culture of ownership, governance, and regulatory discipline by holding self and others accountable for delivering commitments, maintaining compliance standards, and achieving operational objectives.
   

  

 Promote transparency through performance monitoring, timely escalation of risks and findings, and the effective execution of corrective actions to ensure sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
   

  

 Join us to shape world\-class quality assurance and compliance programs, strengthen regulatory excellence, and drive safe, efficient, and industry\-leading operations across the organization.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, y ou will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in airline quality assurance and compliance.
   

  

 You are expected to demonstrate an in\-depth knowledge of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you even more if you are able to lead a team, and are familiar with GACA (General Authority of Civil Aviation) regulations.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders like the FM department.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Would you like to be part of a team focused on driving innovation in the transportation industry while working to empower entrepreneurs and contribute to Amazon’s sustainability goals?
   

  

 Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Delivery Partner Managers assists and guides our Amazon DSPs (Logistics Supply chain Managers) business owners as they build and grow successful middle\-mile businesses during a transformational time.
   

  

 Account Manager (Logistics Supply chain Manager) manage the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Logistics Supply chain Manager, work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level, influence their business planning and strategy, and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Logistics Account Manager, you will manage a team of 6\+ Managers to manage 80\+ DSP accounts in Amazon's quick commerce business (15min and 2H delivery) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia including entrepreneurs with no background in the logistics industry, or seasoned logistics carrier (Depending on business program)
   

  

 Work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics.
   

  

 Collaborate with an integrated internal team of Program Managers and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements.
   

  

 Support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level.
   

  

 As Lead, Logistics Supply chain Manager will do this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
   

  

 They will collaborate frequently with a wide array of integrated internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, fleet and network health to name a few. **Job Description**

 The Director of Facilities Management provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the full lifecycle management of the organisation’s built and natural assets. This role oversees the planning, mobilisation, operation, and continuous improvement of all Facilities Management (FM) and Landscape Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across a complex, multi‑site programme, ensuring world‑class service delivery, promoting best\-practice asset management, and acts as a Senior advisor to the Executive Leadership, Government Agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





 The Facilities Management Director is responsible to provide the overall Landscape Operations and Maintenance support to RCRC during the lifecycle of all programme components.
   

  

  

  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance**



* Develop and implement the organisation’s comprehensive FM and Landscape O\&M strategy aligned with long‑term corporate objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance management systems, SLAs, and KPIs for all FM disciplines (hard, soft, infrastructure, and landscape).
* Lead strategic asset management planning, including lifecycle cost modelling, capital replacement strategies, and sustainability\-focused asset performance improvements.
* Represent the FM function at executive committees, senior leadership briefings, and cross‑government steering groups.



  

  





**2\. Lifecycle \& Operational Management**



* Provide expert guidance throughout the full asset lifecycle: design review, mobilisation, operation, maintenance, optimisation, and decommissioning.
* Ensure that all assets and facilities achieve optimal operational availability, resilience, and compliance.
* Direct the mobilisation of FM and O\&M contracts, establish operational readiness programmes, and oversee contractor onboarding and performance.
* Ensure operations integrate seamlessly with the broader urban, environmental, and community context.



  

  





**3\. Procurement, Contracts \& Commercial Oversight**



* Lead the development of procurement strategies, technical documentation, scopes of work, and high‑quality RFPs for all FM and O\&M services.
* Manage the full tendering process including bid evaluation, technical and commercial assessment, negotiation, and contract award.
* Maintain full budgetary and financial control, ensuring cost forecasting, contract variations, cash\-flow analysis, and risk/opportunity tracking are accurate and timely.
* Drive value engineering, cost optimisation, and commercial innovation across the FM portfolio.



  

  





**4\. Performance, Compliance \& Risk Management**



* Ensure all facilities, operations, and contractors comply with regulatory, statutory, environmental, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee the creation of risk registers, emergency preparedness plans, and business continuity strategies.
* Implement quality assurance frameworks to monitor performance and ensure consistent, high‑quality delivery across all service providers.
* Conduct regular reviews of O\&M delivery, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective measures.



  

  





**5\. Stakeholder \& Client Leadership**



* Serve as the senior point of contact for government entities, municipalities, regulatory bodies, clients, community groups, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead high‑level presentations, executive reporting, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
* Build strong collaborative relationships with partners, service providers, and cross‑functional teams to ensure organisational alignment.



  

  





**6\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development**



* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of FM, landscape, engineering, and O\&M professionals.
* Cultivate a high‑performance culture emphasising accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and drive training, succession planning, and professional development initiatives.

* Extensive experience (15\+ years) in Facilities \& Asset Management of large, complex, multi\-site environments.
* Deep knowledge of O\&M across hard services, soft services, infrastructure, and large\-scale landscape environments.


**Qualifications**

 Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, bachelor’s degree in urban design, architecture or landscape or Equivalent

 Years of Experience (min) 15

* Review, analyse, and prepare HSE data, dashboards, reports, and trend analysis for internal and client use.
* Lead audits, inspections, and assurance activities across the portfolio.
* Lead and oversee incident investigations, ensuring robust root cause analysis and lessons learned.

**Purpose Of The Role (Overview)**

Provide comment and advice to the HGS Construction Director if the communications contain information pertaining to ongoing and or new contractual issues
* Compile draft Notices, Instructions, Variation Orders, Letters and Reports, as necessary, for review and submission by the HGS Construction Director

* Attend Weekly Commercial \& Procurement Meetings; and contribute to the discussions therein. Review and comment of the Meeting Minutes (prepared by the Cost Consultant)
* Attend other meetings as required by the HGS Construction Director
* Assist in the preparation of HGS daily, weekly and monthly reports and presentations
* Liaise with HGS Project Construction Director, Construction Manager, Planning Manager and Document Controller, escalating issues of concern as necessary.
* Liaise with the Employer's Cost Consultant, Contractor's Commercial Manager, Contractor's Procurement Manager and the Employer Construction Supervision Consultant. Escalate arising matters of concern to the HGS Construction Director
* Assist in other ad\-hoc, site related, activities as requested by the HGS Construction Director, e.g., Emergency Drills, Head\-Counts, etc
* Undertake other Commercial, Contract and Procurement related tasks as necessary


**Other Attributes :**
 1 . Comfortable working in a site office, alongside an Employer Team including Employer's Consultants.
   

  

 2 . Willingness to step outside the designated role of Commercial Manager to undertake additional work activities in support of the wider HGS role on the Prime Business Resort project.
   

  

 3 . Physically fit, able to "walk the site" to access all areas of the construction works to view and gauge the progress and status of the construction works.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Experience and Qualifications**
* Ten (10\) years post\-qualification, post\-contract / construction delivery, Commercial Management experience
* B.Sc. / B.A. Degree (3\-4 year) in a construction related subject from a reputable, recognized, university
* Experience of projects of varying types and complexities; experience of Business Park / Low\-Rise Office developments of a similar size and nature to the Prime Business Resort project preferred
* Five (5\) years Contract Administration of Construction Projects experience using the FIDIC Red Book Form of Contract (FIDIC Red Book 1999 experience required)
* Five years' work experience in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia / GCC Countries in the capacity of a Commercial / Contracts Manager
* Five (5\) years employment with an International Consultancy Company
* Experience in administering FIDIC White Book 2017 Consultancy Services Agreements
* Experience of site (office) based working
* Accomplished user of Aconex, SharePoint and the Microsoft Office Suite of software
* Ability to engage with and assist the project's Cost Consultant, the Contractor's Commercial Manager and Procurement Manager; and the Construction Supervision Consultant, in a decisive, non\-adversarial manner
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RCIS) preferred

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

 This is a hands\-on project delivery role focused on the site\-based execution of solar PV projects from mobilisation, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and project controls through to quality inspections, commissioning, documentation, and handover.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the VP of Execution, you will act as YDE’s on\-site representative, ensuring EPC contractors deliver safely, on schedule, within budget, and in line with YDE’s technical, contractual, HSE, and quality standards.
   

  

 This role is best suited to a project professional with strong solar PV construction experience, practical engineering knowledge, and the discipline to manage daily site execution, contractor performance, project controls, variations, and reporting in a fast\-moving, site\-based environment.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred; Mechanical or Civil Engineering may also be considered.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in project management or site engineering for EPC/construction projects.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in solar PV or renewable energy projects.
* Hands\-on experience managing solar PV construction sites, including DC and AC electrical works, mounting structure installation, inverter commissioning, and grid interconnection.
* Strong experience coordinating EPC contractors and project subcontractors, including progress tracking, RFIs, submittals, variation inputs, payment application review, project documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* BESS or hybrid energy project experience.
* Arabic language skills or strong experience working in Arabic\-speaking site environments.


 You’ll Thrive Here If...
   

  

 You are likely to succeed in this role if you are a hands\-on project professional who is comfortable being close to the work, coordinating EPC contractors and site teams with technical credibility, and managing the detail required to deliver high\-quality solar PV projects.
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who**

 At Yellow Door Energy, you’ll be part of a leading sustainable energy company delivering real impact across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 You’ll work on high\-impact solar PV and clean energy projects, alongside experienced renewable energy professionals, in a culture that values safety, ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Overview**
 The ITS Director for Fare Collection Systems with a minimum of 12 years senior technical and management experience and a university degree, shall be responsible for the overall management, performance, and integration of the fare collection system of the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) across the Public Transport Network. This includes AFC (Automatic Fare Collection), CCC (Customer Contact Center) and associated systems and interfaces, including integration with external stakeholders such as the Metro Network. He shall ensure that the interfaces between the ITS Contractors and the other project transport operators are efficient and implemented in sufficient time to allow for the smooth operation of the Bus and metro systems. He shall be responsible for all ITS\-related technical deliverables on behalf of the Employer and shall ensure that no scope or responsibility gaps exist across Contractors or systems. He shall be responsible for system performance, revenue management, Central Clearing House, stakeholder reporting, vendor management and compliance with RCRC/contract obligations. The role ensures that all ITS systems operate efficiently, meet contractual KPIs, and support seamless public transport operations across around 1,000 metro and bus stations.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Oversee the performance, reliability of the Fare collection systems including AFC, CCC as well as all integration with AVM and Journey Planning systems.
* Ensure effective interface management between Bus Contractors, ITS Contractors, and external systems and stakeholders such as Metro.
* Monitor system performance and resolve inconsistencies, faults, and integration issues.
* Ensure robust revenue collection and management processes are implemented between the operators and the Client finance department.
* Ensure contractors meet contractual KPIs and performance targets.
* Oversee maintenance, backup, cybersecurity, and data protection practices for all systems.
* Lead vendor and contractor management related to ITS systems.
* Ensure proper implementation of software management best practices and data security requirements.
* Review and approve all technical deliverables submitted by ITS contractors.
* Identify and close any responsibility gaps related to ITS scope.
* Ensure timely implementation of interfaces to support smooth bus operations.
* Lead stakeholder reporting related to ITS performance and compliance.
* Support operational readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Qualification \& Education Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor degree in Engineering, IT, or related field


**Mandatory Experience**
* Minimum 12 years of experience in ITS and transport systems or related fields
* Proven experience in managing large\-scale ITS systems integrations and management of their operations and maintenance
* Experience in contractor and stakeholder management
* Strong understanding of system interfaces, software management, and cybersecurity
* Experience in KPI monitoring and performance management


**Additional Notes**
* Proven ability to lead diverse, multidisciplinary teams and foster a culture of technical excellence.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to manage complex, multi\-contractor environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Full\-time on project site in Riyadh

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Commercial Strategy Director will lead the strategic commercialization, launch readiness, and execution planning for Vertex’s asset in glomerular diseases including IgA nephropathy across the GCC markets, with a primary focus on Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 This role is accountable for shaping and executing the GCC portfolio strategy, identifying and driving market\-shaping opportunities, and ensuring alignment with Vertex’s global priorities and cross\-functional objectives.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership, deep market understanding, and strong cross\-functional influence to accelerate access, optimize launch execution, and position Vertex as a leading innovator in glomerular diseases within the region. The role requires a leadership mindset grounded in ambition, anticipation, and agility, with the ability to proactively navigate evolving healthcare environments and deliver sustainable business impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of the GCC commercial strategy for Povetacicept, ensuring alignment with Vertex’s global vision and regional healthcare transformation priorities.
* Drive launch excellence initiatives, go\-to\-market planning, customer engagement strategies, value proposition development, and access readiness efforts specific to glomerular diseases, including IgA Nephropathy.
* Identify, prioritize, and maximize commercial opportunities across the GCC markets through deep understanding of market dynamics, healthcare policies, competitive landscape, and evolving standards of care.
* Operate with a high degree of strategic anticipation and agility to proactively address evolving market conditions, and emerging business opportunities and risks.
* Own delivery against agreed commercial and strategic objectives, ensuring strong execution against revenue, growth, operational, and efficiency KPIs.
* Generate and consolidate actionable market insights across HCPs and patient stakeholders to inform strategic decision\-making and brand planning.
* Lead cross\-functional launch readiness efforts in partnership in participation with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Government and Public Affairs (GAPP), and International Patient Engagement (IPE), Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure coordinated and successful product launches.
* Partner closely with international IHQ teams to drive strategic and operational alignment required to address evolving markets and healthcare system needs.
* Drive launch excellence through disciplined planning, execution governance, risk mitigation, and performance tracking across all launch phases.
* Drive integrated strategic planning and operational excellence across internal stakeholders, ensuring customer and market needs are effectively translated into execution plans and organizational priorities.
* Develop robust business cases supporting investment decisions, resource allocation, capability building, and portfolio expansion across the region.
* Collaborate within external nephrology and glomerular disease ecosystem through strategic engagement with scientific leaders, healthcare institutions, policymakers, and advocacy stakeholders.
* Represents the GCC region in regional and global strategic forums, ensuring GCC needs and insights are reflected in broader organizational planning.
* Represents Vertex externally at scientific meetings, conferences, industry events, and strategic engagement to strengthen the company’s profile and support long\-term business development opportunities.
* Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in full compliance with Vertex code of conduct, SOPs and all applicable laws and regulations across GCC markets.


 Required Education Level
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences or related discipline and/ or MBA or advanced business degree


**Required Experience**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including significant experience in commercial strategy, specialty launches, or rare disease commercialization.
* Demonstrated experience leading launch preparation and commercial execution within specialty or innovative therapeutic areas.
* Prior experience in nephrology, rare diseases or specialty care is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience across GCC markets, with Saudi Arabia experience considered essential.


**Required Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong cross\-functional leadership capabilities with proven ability to operate effectively within complex matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success in developing and implementing commercial strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. Experience in successfully launching innovative and preferably rare disease therapies in GCC healthcare systems.
* Deep understanding of GCC healthcare systems, healthcare transformation agendas, market access environments, and stakeholder ecosystems.
* Proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams and senior leadership levels.
* Strong track record of effectively engaging with healthcare providers, and government stakeholders in the GCC.
* Strong analytical, financial, and business acumen with ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.
* High level of ambition, accountability, agility, and execution focus, with ability to manage competing priorities in fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate challenges, navigate uncertainty, and lead through complexity and change.
* Strong project management and operational planning capabilities.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills.
* Sound understanding of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements across GCC markets.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.


**Other Requirements**
* Frequent travel within GCC may be required.
* Position is based in Riyadh, KSA.

 Hybrid\-Eligible Or On\-Site Eligible

 Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

data.jd_text:
**HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?**
 As the
 **Commercial Director** 
 , your main mission is to lead the commercial strategy of Cartier in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, leading our internal and external partnership network, manage sales forecasts and set mid and long\-term sales strategies in line with Maison’s ambition. You will manage sales force to achieve sales and profit goals and will lead the performance, profitability, growth and optimization of the network in line with the Maison’s and the market’s strategy. As the Commercial Director, you will also build on the Maison’s local initiatives across Retail, Specialist Retail, Prestige, and e\-Commerce.
   

  

 Reporting to the Managing Director and as part of the KSA Executive Committee, you will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Strategy and Business Development**
* Build the commercial part of the market’s strategic 3\-year\-plan in collaboration with the Managing Director.
* Contribute to the Network Development strategy to leverage relevant business opportunities across the market (Real Estate, Boutique projects).
* Contribute to the branding plan by developing ideas for communications and PR to elevate brand perception amongst existing and new potential clients, while creating a consistent brand message across all channels.
* Lead the development of the high\-end business across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
* Define and implement the local high\-end strategy integrating Prestige community development, relevant high\-end stock representation, VIP client development and branding initiatives in cooperation with Marketing, Communication and Client teams.
* Act as a local expert by developing a deep understanding of the competitive landscape, surrounding community and important events, trends, etc.


**Commercial Performance**
* Set realistic and ambitious sales targets.
* Analyze market KPIs and identify priority actions to achieve targets and business growth.
* Monitor the network’s P\&L (Boutiques’ profitability).
* Support the regional merchandising team by communicating the opportunities and needs of the Cartier brand in the market.


**Network Development and Performance Management**
* In collaboration with the Managing Director and Regional Real Estate Director, lead negotiations with current landlords and with future projects.
* Lead the New Projects’ brief, obtain necessary validations and overview the design process for all new boutiques and point of sale.
* Ensure that retail sales targets are achieved In line with the Maison’s and the market’s global strategy.
* Set Boutique sales targets after consultation of other local departments.
* Ensure the monitoring and follow up of the Boutiques’ Commercial Action Plans.
* Manage watch specialists from researching performance metrics and ensuring market compliance.
* Drive the Boutique \& POS Operations Excellence through implementation of appropriate policies, procedures and tools and a strong compliance mindset.
* Ensure that the Maison’s standards in terms of client experience (Satisfaction Barometer) are respected and known throughout the network.


**Client Strategy \& Development**
* Contribute to the overall Client strategy by infusing client\-centric mindset amongst all the Commercial teams with the priority objective of improving client satisfaction, loyalty \& recruitment.
* In coordination with the Client Department, ensure development of relevant Boutique clienteling initiatives, CRM capabilities and implementation of client portfolio management across entire network.
* Represent Cartier as an Ambassador of the Maison and the market during international and local events and with VIP clients.


**External Retail Partnership**
* Lead the retailization of the watch POS network to elevate commercial performance and provide a consistent message with Retail.
* Enhance retail partnerships through key account management.
* Explore new business opportunities to accelerate the Maison growth and leadership in Market.


**Omni\-channel\- Digital Retail ecosystem**
* Ensure a seamless Omni\-channel approach leveraging Cartier digital \& e\-commerce environment to elevate user experience.
* In Collaboration with regional team, build a strategy to develop e\-Commerce in Market.
* Contribute to identify opportunities with relevant stakeholders to enhance e\-Commerce client experience, notably through delivery lead time reductions and optimization of digital media investment.
* Oversee the e\-commerce hub and ensure optimization of KPIs related to quality of service.


**Talent Management \& Development**
* Develop, retain, and attract a high\-performing teams in office and Boutiques.
* Share vision, strategy, and values of the Maison to engage and motivate all teams around them.
* Actively participate in succession planning for all commercial teams.


**What Are We Looking For**
* Minimum of 15\+ years of commercial / client\-facing experience in a multinational organisation with a master’s degree in business administration or equivalent
* Retail Acumen
* Strategic Thinking
* Data Driven supported by a rounded commercial awareness
* Digital mindset
* Experience in working transversally with all key functions in a market/HQ
* Demonstrated the ability to deal with ambiguity
* Ability to navigate in complex international environments
* Flexibility to adapt quickly to changing circumstances
* Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact/collaborate within a team.
* Ability to navigate in complex international environments.
* Fluent preferably in multiple languages with spoken and written English and Arabic mandatory (additional language skills are a plus).


**What Do We Offer**
 At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive.
   

  

 We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences.
   

  

 We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity.
   

  

 We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging.
   

  

**Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward.**
