* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


  

  

* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


  

  

- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support

**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design.
   

  

 From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design (PDD) Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel.
   

  

 If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry.
   

  

 Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Integration Specialist, you will support the planning, coordination, and controlled execution of digital product, platform, system, and third\-party integration activities across the IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience portfolio. Working under the direct guidance of the Product Integration Manager, you will help ensure that product features, interfaces, and dependent solutions are integrated in line with approved business requirements, technical specifications, delivery timelines, and quality standards.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused, coordination\-heavy role. You will be the person who keeps integration activity organised, documented, and on track — maintaining the artefacts, monitoring the dependencies, supporting testing cycles, and ensuring nothing falls through the gaps between teams. You will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, and vendor teams, acting as a reliable point of coordination across complex, multi\-stakeholder workstreams.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Product Integration Manager, who sits within the broader IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience function led by the Head of IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded delivery specialist to build deep expertise in connected cabin platforms and grow within a team that is shaping the future of inflight digital experience.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

 Integration Coordination and Support
   

  

* Support the coordination of end\-to\-end integration activities for assigned initiatives, ensuring requirements, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables are documented and tracked in line with the integration plan
* Assist the Product Integration Manager in translating business, product, and functional requirements into structured integration plans, interface activities, and implementation work packages
* Liaise with product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, cyber security, operations, and vendor teams as directed, supporting alignment on solution design, interface readiness, and deployment planning
* Coordinate with internal technical teams and third\-party suppliers to help validate interface specifications, technical dependencies, configuration readiness, and integration deliverables


 Delivery Tracking and Risk Support
   

  

* Monitor integration milestones and flag delivery risks, defects, and blockers to the Product Integration Manager in a timely and structured manner
* Maintain risk and issue logs, tracking mitigation actions and resolution progress across active integration workstreams
* Support the escalation process by preparing clear, factual summaries of delivery concerns for review by the Product Integration Manager


 Documentation and Artefact Management
   

  

* Prepare, maintain, and update integration artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface registers, dependency logs, test plans, defect logs, deployment checklists, and operational readiness documentation
* Ensure all artefacts are accurate, version\-controlled, and accessible to relevant stakeholders throughout the integration lifecycle
* Support the production of structured status reports, meeting documentation, and governance inputs as directed by the Product Integration Manager
* Testing and Release Support
* Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and release readiness activities by coordinating inputs, tracking outcomes, and following up on remediation actions
* Help ensure that implementation activities are carried out in line with change governance, release controls, and service continuity requirements as defined by the Product Integration Manager and broader governance frameworks
* Assist with cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and transition\-to\-support activities to help ensure integrated solutions are deployed and stabilised smoothly


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Capture post\-implementation observations, lessons learned, and service performance insights, and share these with the Product Integration Manager to support continuous improvement in integration delivery
* Contribute to team knowledge by maintaining up\-to\-date records, sharing delivery insights, and identifying opportunities to improve integration coordination processes


**Be part of an extraordinary story**
 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
   

  

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
   

  

 High School or Vocational Qualification with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in project coordination, systems integration support, or digital product delivery.
   

  

**Essential**
* Proven experience in a project delivery, systems integration, or digital product coordination role, with a track record of supporting structured delivery programmes in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment
* Good understanding of digital product delivery and systems integration principles, including awareness of dependencies across applications, platforms, services, and third\-party solutions
* Ability to develop and maintain structured delivery artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface inventories, issue logs, deployment records, and operational readiness documentation
* Hands\-on experience supporting testing and release activities including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, and cutover support
* Strong coordination and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, product, engineering, operations, and vendor teams
* Ability to monitor delivery progress, maintain risk and issue logs, and communicate concerns clearly and promptly to senior team members
* Working familiarity with change control, release governance, and service transition processes within a structured delivery environment
* Clear and organized written communication skills with the ability to produce accurate status reports, meeting notes, and governance documentation


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a connected digital platform, consumer technology, media, or enterprise systems environment
* Familiarity with IFEC systems, connected cabin platforms, or aviation digital product environments is advantageous but not required
* Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, data flows, and service integration concepts
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies within product or transformation programmes
* Experience coordinating with external vendors and third\-party suppliers in a delivery context
* Exposure to UI/UX product development environments and an interest in digital passenger or consumer experience


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.

**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 14th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, Algeria, Egypt, and Venezuela — the Group manages a complex, multi\-currency portfolio of businesses and investments requiring sophisticated treasury leadership.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head of Treasury will be responsible for leading the Group’s capital structure, liquidity, funding strategy, and financial risk management framework. This is a critical executive role acting as the primary interface with international banking partners, credit institutions, and institutional stakeholders, ensuring robust financial governance, funding efficiency, and strategic capital allocation across the Group.

* Lead debt restructuring, refinancing, and capital optimization initiatives
* Develop and execute group\-wide funding and leverage strategies
* Manage corporate borrowing facilities and covenant compliance
* Present treasury strategy to CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee



**Syndicated Loans \& Banking** 



* Structure and negotiate syndicated and bilateral credit facilities with international banks
* Manage global banking relationships and lender communications
* Oversee loan documentation and legal coordination



**Liquidity \& Cash Management** 



* Oversee global liquidity, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization
* Implement cash pooling and intercompany funding structures
* Ensure adequate liquidity buffers across all entities



**Risk Management** 



* Design FX, interest rate, and commodity hedging strategies
* Manage derivatives, ISDA agreements, and hedge accounting compliance (IFRS 9\)



**Governance \& Strategy** 



* Develop treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks
* Deliver treasury reporting to Board and external stakeholders
* Support M\&A, capital raising, and strategic finance initiatives
* Lead and develop the treasury team



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Essential** 



* 18\+ years of treasury experience, including 8\+ years in senior leadership roles
* Proven experience in debt restructuring and syndicated financing

* Experience within large corporates, conglomerates, or investment holding groups
* Strong understanding of financial instruments and credit documentation (LMA preferred)

**Desirable** 



* SAP TRM or treasury management systems experience
* Exposure to GCC, MENA, Africa, or frontier markets

**Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Presence

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The incumbent is directly responsible for leading the team responsible for selling Qatari (GCC) Equities and fixed income products to institutional clients based locally, regionally, and globally. SVP of Sales must proactively identify client needs and goals that can be served and grow business (revenue) with client(s). The incumbent is also responsible for monitoring and oversight of development and integration of all QNBFS Customer Services delivery channels (Institutional, Corporate, HNWI, Retail) including Call Center and Customer service help desk.
   

  

 SVP of Sales is responsible for developing strategic relationships and marketing the Liquidity Provisioning/Market Making as well as Service Agreements to potential LP client companies. SVP of Sales must be proficient in representation of LP/MM value proposition to prospects and existing clients. The incumbent must function in collaboration with Head of Research and Head of LP/Market Making and assist them in matching LP clients with suitable/specifically targeted international/regional investors, organizing road shows and preparing presentation materials.
   

  

 SVP of Sales must monitor customer satisfaction at each stakeholder level and initiate changes needed to increase satisfaction scores. SVP of Sales must oversee sales team efforts to identify and build a long\-term active pipeline, exploring both existing markets and targeting new market opportunities. The role requires taking complete ownership ofdevelopmentanddeliveryofexceptionaldocumentsandpresentationstocreatewinningoutcomes. The incumbent is responsible for development, implementation and maintenance of applicable QNBFS policies and procedures.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 Develop a sales strategy and sales plan in line with the market and industry trends, strategic objectives, client segments, target market, regulatory regime and organizations’ strengths and weakness.
   

  

 Develop QNBFS Customer Service strategy/plan in close consultation with the heads of QNBFS Departments.
   

  

 Grow and manage pipeline based on sales targets, forecasts and performance goals to increase company’s market share as well as to monitor service levels to increase customer retention.
   

  

 Operate within the target departmental Budgets defined in the budget process.
   

  

 Implements and meet KPI’s and best practices monitor sales efforts across all business lines as well as customer service / Call Center performance monitoring for quality measurement purposes.
   

  

 Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimize cost, avoid waste, and optimize benefits for the bank.
   

  

 Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
   

  

 Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
   

  

 Build and strengthen distribution channels and ensure adequate monitoring \& oversight on all QNBFS Customer Services delivery channels as well as call center.
   

  

 Stay abreast with and analyze market research used by customer service team to develop service delivery channels to ensure its effectiveness to attract new customers to company and retain existing customers.
   

  

 Developing close relationships with CEO’s, CFO’s, CIO’s and senior management teams across the industry
   

  

 Gather information on competitors offering, building and maintaining a client profile enabling QNBFS to target its offering scientifically.
   

  

 Work with the Trading / Research departments to develop new marketing themes.
   

  

 Travel as needed to meet regional institutions for business building business relationships
   

  

 Resolve customer complaints in a timely and professional manner.

data.jd_text:
Mandarin Oriental, Doha is looking for a Director of Commercial Strategy to join our team.
   

  

 Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari\-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Commercial Strategy Department in Doha, the Director of Commercial Strategy is responsible for setting the hotel’s strategic business direction by balancing financial objectives, managing sales segments and guiding the commercial strategies of the hotel. Works with General Manager, Director of Marketing Communications and Director of Revenue to develop and implement the hotels commercial strategy to maximize hotel revenues, market share performance and profits. Director of Marketing and Director of Revenue will report directly to the Director of Commercial Strategy. Responsible for maximizing revenue and profit associated with rooms, function space and total revenue as required. Position is accountable for all transient, group and catering segments and deployment, pricing, channel distribution and positioning. Identifies future revenue opportunities and effectively communicates strategies to the sales and marketing colleagues. Oversees the Revenue department and all the processes associated with them such as demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management and proactive opportunity analysis. Oversees both the Revenue Department and the Marketing Department, including all processes associated with demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management, proactive opportunity analysis, and marketing communications. The Director of Commercial Strategy reports to the General Manager.
   

  

**As Director of Commercial Strategy, you will be responsible for the following duties:**
* Together with Director of Marketing Communications and Director of Revenue Management, prepares the hotel’s annual budget and develops, implements and adapts the Annual Marketing Plan as market conditions fluctuate.
* Responsible for annual expenditure for all sales activities and control of the budgeted expenditure by a monthly forecast.
* Develops the business outlook and commercial strategy for the hotel and ensures the strategies conform to MOHG’s brand philosophies, guidelines and initiatives at all times.
* Provides strategic direction as it related to pricing, inventory, channel management and distribution of all market segments in accordance to MOHG’s brand guidelines.
* Proactively analyzes and communicates business trends and booking pace in comparison to the market, last year, forecast and budget.
* Analyzes competitive sets, price positioning, seasonality, mix and displacement on a weekly basis.
* Establishes and maintains effective and rational pricing strategies for all inventories and market segments.
* Oversees the annual pricing process for transient, group and catering rooms, function spaces and other areas as required.


**As Director Of Commercial Strategy, We Expect From You**
* Senior School qualifications and Degree or Higher National Diploma equivalent in Hospitality Management.
* Minimum 10\-year experience in Revenue Management
* Must have minimum 10\-year experience in Sales with MOHG or another similar hotel company
* Leadership experience minimum of 10 years with experience in handling all sales segments
* Experience of minimum 5 years of managing large teams.
* Preferable to experience in the GCC.


**Our commitment to you**
* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.
* A competitive salary and benefits packages
* Transportation and Housing provided
* Relocation and Vacation Tickets


**We’re Fans. Are you?**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 The Lead Information Security Officer for Asset Management is a critical leadership position responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing the comprehensive information security and cybersecurity risk posture specifically within the Asset Management Private business. This role is pivotal in balancing commercial objectives with robust security controls, ensuring the division's resilience against an evolving threat landscape, and protecting client assets and data.
   

  

 This leader will directly manage and provide strategic direction to teams responsible for Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC), Application Security \& Advisory, and Product Security functions within Asset Management. Crucially, this role also involves the oversight and guidance of embedded Technology Risk Officers who are assigned to various Asset Management Private business vertical. The objective is to foster a unified and proactive approach to risk management, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enabling secure technological innovation across all Asset Management initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work with internal application development teams that are developing the next generation of critical business applications, enable them to understand Information Security and Business Resiliency control requirements, and advise on the integration of these controls into their applications
* Collaborate with the global Application Security Risk, Business Continuity, Risk Measurement, and other global Technology Risk teams to develop and integrate best\-in\-class security and resiliency controls and practices.
* Communicate the impact of technology risks and the approach to mitigation/acceptance and provide risk assessment and advisory services to technology engineers, and technology and business management.
* Assess existing applications for design\-related security risks and assist teams in determining appropriate remediation steps
* Provide guidance to engineering leadership and application developers on existing and emerging threats in the web and mobile application space.
* Drive adoption of embedded application security controls as part of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Provide deep subject matter expertise to application teams in secure application design and development approaches and techniques.
* Contribute to the technical understanding, adoption and convergence of information security standards, solutions and tools.
* Work with engineers to develop customized security testing strategy to complement the existing security testing program managed by Technology Risk.


**Skills And Experience Required**
* Experience: 5\+ years of progressive experience in Multi domain Information Security experience such as vendor security, application security, vulnerability management, data loss prevention, data encryption, and infrastructure security.
* Regulatory \& Risk Expertise: Expert knowledge of global financial regulations (e.g., SEC , FINRA , GDPR , CCPA ) and proven experience applying risk management methodologies such as FAIR (Factor Analysis of Information Risk) or similar frameworks.
* Leadership \& Management: Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead high\-performing global teams of security professionals.
* Program Management: Proven track record involving collaboration with engineering, technology, second line risk functions and audit partners to deliver projects and facilitate resolution of audit issues within committed timelines.
* Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical risks and solutions clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* Risk Management: Expertise in performing risk assessments, identifying gaps in compliance with information security policies, and recommending effective mitigation strategies.
* Security Standards: Familiarity with leading security standards and frameworks such as NIST, OWASP, SANS Top 20, PCI DSS, and CIS Controls.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in Technology Risk data analytics (metrics reporting and dashboarding) and Reviewing Software Development Lifecycle best practices e.g., code reviews, vulnerability scan report analysis to advise application development teams on for secure practices and frameworks, and other application security best practices


**Preferred Qualifications**
* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related technical field.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP , CISM , CRISC , CISA, or cloud\-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security – Specialty).
* Experience with leveraging AI/ML to solve security problems and scale operations.
* Knowledge of secure coding languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).

Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 This section’s primary responsibility is to make sure that all Bonds/Securities/IRS Options, transactions have correctly been entered in the system – verified with Reuter/Email confirmations –The payment instructions are correctly entered as per SSI and Reuter confirmation – and the payment has been made in time – and the inward interbank Vostro payment orders from Vostro banks have been accurately processed from Financial Institutions Vostro accounts. Supervise the workflow and make sure all transactions done by Front Office have been accurately processed.

* 45 Billion QAR Volume of business per annum

* Ensure Periodical Reporting to the management and Central Bank as per policy.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview** 




**AX Coin (a member of AXG) is the first and only licensed stablecoin issuer under the regulation of the Central Bank of Bahrain.** 
 We are seeking an Associate Director of Reserve who will help with all banking, financial institution, and payment rail relationships. The Associate Director of Reserve is responsible for designing and operating the banking, settlement, liquidity, and payment infrastructure that underpins AX Coin’s stablecoin issuance and payments ecosystem. This is a highly execution\-focused role requiring deep understanding of transaction banking, settlement, and regulated payment flows.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.Banking and FI Relationship** 




 Manage strategic relationships with custodian banks and partner financial institutions to ensure the security and efficient operation of reserve custody accounts.
 



**2\.Reserve Composition and Compliance Management** 




 Strictly comply with Chapter 6 of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBB SIO Module to ensure full compliance of reserve assets with respect to ratings, maturities, and currencies. Establish and maintain a 1:1 integrity verification mechanism for reserve assets, and monitor daily to ensure the market value of reserve assets never falls below the total face value of stablecoins in circulation.
 



**3\.Liquidity Management and Stress Testing** 




 Manage asset maturity structures to ensure high liquidity for real\-time minting and redemption demands. Design and execute stress tests under extreme market conditions such as a redemption crunch to ensure the reserve pools resilience.
 



**4\.Yield and Risk Balance** 




 Operate a yield\-bearing stablecoin model within legal and compliance frameworks.
 



**5\.Audit, Reporting and Segregation** 




 Work with accounting firms to complete monthly or quarterly Proof of Reserves audits. Ensure strict physical segregation of reserve assets from corporate operating funds via segregated accounts. Submit reserve asset composition reports to the Central Bank of Bahrain at the required frequency.
 



**6\.Payment Rail and Settlement Architecture** 




 Lead the design, integration, and maintenance of fiat on\-ramp and off\-ramp channels. Establish and manage the connection between settlement accounts and payment partners.
 



**7\.Liquidity Flow Design and Oversight** 




 Define and govern the fiat clearing and settlement mechanisms within the stablecoin minting and redemption processes to ensure efficient and transparent fund movement.
 



**8\.Reconciliation and Operational Coordination** 




 Establish a three\-party reconciliation mechanism among fund flows, asset flows, and on\-chain data to ensure consistency between circulating supply, reserves, and in\-transit funds. Act as the primary point of contact for banking and payment partners to resolve abnormal operational interruptions.
 



**9\.Regional Expansion Support** 




 Support and expand the companys banking and payment capabilities across EMEA Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



**10\.Stakeholder and Partner Management** 




 Work closely with compliance, product, and operations teams to ensure all payment processes and reserve management activities adhere to AML, sanctions screening, and Central Bank of Bahrain regulatory requirements.
 



  





  





**Key Requirements** 




  





**1\.Experience** 



* Industry Experience: 5\+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: payments, transaction banking, treasury management, financial infrastructure; asset management, asset\-liability management ALM, fixed income investment, asset custody; experience supporting regulated financial products or platforms such as stablecoins or electronic money institutions.
* Regional Experience: Experience working with financial institutions, fintechs, or regulatory bodies in Bahrain or the Middle East is preferred.



  





**2\.Professional Skills and Knowledge** 




**Regulatory Knowledge:** 



* Deep understanding of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBBs stablecoin regulatory framework, particularly the SIO Module requirements for eligible reserve assets.
* Familiarity with AML and sanctions screening requirements in the payments space.



**Payments and Settlement:** 



* Strong understanding of payment systems, settlement mechanisms, and liquidity management.
* Hands\-on experience onboarding and maintaining bank partnerships and payment rails.



**Investment and Risk Control:** 



* Familiarity with short\-term fixed income investments and asset\-liability duration matching.
* Capability in liquidity risk modeling and stress testing.



**Reconciliation and Operations:** 



* Ability to design and implement complex multi\-party reconciliation processes on\-chain vs. bank vs. reserves.



**Tools and Certifications:** 



* CFA, FRM, CAIA, or CAMS certification is preferred.



  





**3\.Soft Skills and Attributes** 



* Strong execution discipline, ability to work under pressure, communication and negotiation skills, and compliance sensitivity.



  





**4\.Must have legal authorization to work in Bahrain.**

Plant Manager – Advanced Composites Manufacturing
 



 Bahrain \| Relocation Package Available \| Tax\-Free Income
 



 We are supporting a highly innovative advanced materials manufacturer based in the Kingdom of Bahrain in the search for a Plant Manager to lead the next phase of growth for their specialist composites manufacturing facility.
 



 This is not a traditional production management role.
 



 The business operates a unique, highly automated manufacturing process supplying advanced reinforcement products to customers worldwide. With significant growth plans, investment opportunities, and new product development initiatives underway, the successful candidate will become a key member of the leadership team and effectively act as the Managing Director's number two.
 



 The facility employs approximately 25 people and operates within a lean, entrepreneurial environment where every team member plays an important role in the success of the business.
 



 The Opportunity
 



 You will take responsibility for the overall performance of the manufacturing facility, including:
 


* Production and operational performance
* Health, Safety \& Environmental management
* Maintenance and equipment reliability
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Quality and continuous improvement initiatives
* Workforce leadership and development
* Operational planning and resource management
* New product development support
* Process optimisation and future growth projects



 This role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of the business rather than simply maintain existing operations.
 



 The company is actively exploring new materials, new applications, sustainability initiatives, process improvements and emerging technologies, including AI\-driven manufacturing solutions.
 



 What We're Looking For
 



 We are keen to speak with experienced manufacturing leaders who can demonstrate:
 


* Plant Management, Operations Management, General Management or Manufacturing Leadership experience
* Experience within composites, advanced materials, technical textiles, nonwovens, polymers, chemicals or related manufacturing sectors
* Strong understanding of composite manufacturing processes and customer applications
* Experience supporting product development, technical innovation or process improvement activities
* A hands\-on leadership style suited to a lean SME environment
* Strong problem\-solving and continuous improvement capability
* Commercial awareness and customer\-focused thinking
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams and driving operational performance



 Experience with composite technologies such as prepreg, SMC, infusion, RTM, pultrusion, compression moulding or similar manufacturing processes would be highly advantageous.
 



 Why Join?
 


* Senior leadership position within a growing international manufacturer
* Opportunity to influence strategy, innovation and future product development
* Tax\-free income in Bahrain
* Relocation support available
* Work alongside an experienced leadership team with a planned handover from a long\-serving Plant Manager
* Genuine opportunity to make a significant impact on the future growth of the business



 This position would particularly suit an experienced Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Technical Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Head of Operations, Head of Technical, General Manager or senior composites professional seeking a broader leadership role within an innovative and growing business.
 



 For a confidential discussion, please contact Red Chilli Recruitment.

**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

**Background**
 The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Country Office in the Kingdom of Bahrain operates within the context of a high\-income, net\-contributing country, where UNDP engagement is fully funded through government cost\-sharing and aligned with national development priorities. Bahrain is implementing an ambitious national reform agenda under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), with a strong focus on economic diversification, fiscal sustainability, effective governance, environmental resilience, digital transformation, and inclusive human development. As a net contributor country, UNDP Bahrain maintains a lean operational footprint while delivering high\-value technical assistance, policy advisory services, and innovation\-driven solutions in support of national priorities.
   

  

 UNDP Bahrain’s programme is guided by the Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, approved by the UNDP Executive Board in January 2025, and is fully aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\. The financial envelope for the 2025–2029 Country Programme Document (CPD) is structured around a total estimated cost of US 2\.5 million for Economic Prosperity (Outcome 1\) and US 5 million for Environmental Sustainability (Outcome 3\). As of late 2025, the Country Office manages seven ongoing projects with a total remaining budget of approximately US$ 1\.8 million. These initiatives are distributed across the three CPD outcomes: Outcome 1 (Economic Prosperity) and Outcome 3 (Environmental Sustainability) each account for about 37–38% of the project count, while Outcome 2 (Governance) makes up the remaining 25%. Notable projects include the SIU and KIP Chemicals initiatives, whereas others like D4SMEs, Rule of Law, and Youth Leadership.
   

  

 The CPD Positions UNDP As a Trusted Strategic Partner To The Government Of Bahrain, Contributing To UNSDCF Outcomes Through Integrated, Multi\-sectoral Interventions That Address Complex Development Challenges At The Intersection Of Economic Prosperity, Governance And Human Rights, And Environmental Sustainability. Under The Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, UNDP Bahrain’s Engagement Is Structured Around Three Interrelated CPD Pillars
   

  

 (i) Economic prosperity and sustainable livelihoods;
   

  

 (ii) Effective governance, human rights, and access to justice; and
   

  

 (iii) Environmental sustainability and climate resilience.
   

  

 These pillars reflect national priorities under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), and constitute UNDP’s substantive contribution to the implementation of the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\.
   

  

 To ensure coherence, integration, and efficient delivery within a lean Country Office structure, the Bahrain CO operationalizes the three CPD pillars through two integrated programme clusters. The first cluster brings together economic transformation, sustainable livelihoods, and environmental sustainability, the second cluster focuses on governance, human rights, access to justice, and social inclusion.
   

  

 This two\-cluster delivery model enables the Country Office to manage complexity, promote synergies across CPD pillars, and apply a portfolio approach to programme design, implementation, and partnerships. Staff are therefore expected to work across thematic boundaries, contribute to integrated solutions, and support joint programming within the UN system, while ensuring results\-based management, quality assurance, and alignment with national and UNSDCF priorities.
   

  

 In this context the Programme Unit works to support achievement of UNDP strategic objectives and to help the Country Office act with both ambition and scale to address urgent problems facing the country, the region, as well as global conditions. Programme staff assist the Country Office in formulating and implementing programme strategies that go beyond solving immediate development challenges to create future smart and integrated systemic changes in resilience and capacity building within the country.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Support formulation of programme strategies and implementation of the Country Programme Documents (CPDs)
* Provide background information for preparation of CPDs and establishment of Baselines, Milestones and Targets (BMT).
* Provide information/evidence to guide future programming and identify implementation arrangements.
* Provide effective support to the management of the Country Office programme.
* Create project in ERP, prepare required budget revisions, revise project status, determine unutilized funds, and ensure operational and financial closure of a project.

We are building a next‑generation private equity platform in Bahrain and are looking for a senior AI leader to embed advanced analytics and GenAI across the full investment lifecycle. This is a hands‑on, high‑visibility role working directly with the investment team and portfolio leadership to turn AI into tangible value creation.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Shape and own the AI strategy across deal sourcing, screening, diligence, IC, portfolio monitoring and exits.

* Partner with operating partners and portfolio management teams to unlock AI‑driven value creation (pricing, revenue analytics, cost efficiency, automation).
* Set AI governance standards covering data privacy, model risk, vendor selection and responsible AI guardrails in a regulated institutional environment.
* Drive firm‑wide adoption through training, playbooks, proof‑of‑concepts and LP‑facing narratives that highlight the firm’s digital edge.



  





**What you bring** 




  




* 10–15 years in AI, data or digital transformation, ideally with experience in PE‑backed businesses, top‑tier consulting or financial services.

* Strong understanding of the private equity lifecycle, IC standards and value creation frameworks – you can translate AI into IRR and MOIC impact.
* Evidence of deploying AI solutions in institutional or regulated environments with robust data privacy and model‑risk practices.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer/Data Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; MBA is an advantage.



  





**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Manama‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity footprint across the GCC and global markets.
* Work at the intersection of AI and private equity in one of the GCC’s most established financial centres, with direct exposure to senior leadership and portfolio C‑suites.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 



* A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

**Overview:** 




  





 As the Academy Head of Medical Services at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will lead the delivery of medical care across the Academy. You will ensure the highest standards of player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding, while providing expert medical guidance to players and staff. You will oversee medical operations, drive best practice, and align all medical provision with the club’s performance objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  





 Lead the delivery of all Academy medical services in collaboration with the Academy Technical Director and Head of Medical Services
 



 Develop and implement an Academy Medical Framework, ensuring player health, wellbeing, and safeguarding
 



 Oversee medical department operations, including clinic management, equipment, and supplies
 



 Design and supervise the work of all Academy medical staff, providing guidance and leadership
 



 Establish and refine medical processes, reporting structures, and communication systems

 Assess, diagnose, and manage musculoskeletal injuries and health\-related conditions affecting Academy players
 



 Interpret medical imaging including X\-rays, CT scans, and MRI to support clinical decisions
 



 Deliver medical screenings and ongoing health assessments for all Academy players
 



 Provide immediate medical care during training and matches
 



 Develop and implement injury prevention strategies and protocols
 



 Coordinate hospital referrals and ensure appropriate medical interventions
 



  





**Collaboration** 




  





 Work closely with Academy and club departments to maintain a safe and high\-performance environment
 



 Communicate effectively with players and their families on medical matters
 



 Act as a key liaison with external medical professionals and specialists
 



  





**Operational and Professional Standards** 




  





 Support Heads of Department on internal matters where required
 



 Ensure all medical staff meet CPD requirements and maintain professional standards
 



 Deliver additional responsibilities as required by senior leadership
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




 Master’s degree in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 PhD in Sports Science, Medicine, or a related field
 



 Specialisation in areas such as rehabilitation, orthopaedics, sports science, physiotherapy, radiology, or biomechanics

 :

 Extensive experience in a medical role within a professional sports environment, ideally football
 



 Strong background in diagnosing, treating, and preventing sports\-related injuries
 



 Experience leading and managing multidisciplinary medical teams
 



 Expertise in rehabilitation and return\-to\-play protocols
 



 Experience working with elite athletes and understanding the demands of professional football
 



 Proven ability to work collaboratively across departments
 



 Formal training and experience in diagnostic procedures, including ultrasound\-guided techniques
 



  





**Desirable** 
 :
 



 Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East
 



 Multilingual capability, including English, Spanish, or Arabic
 



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.

* Lead PMC activities for EPC/LSTK contractor execution of a new 34\.5/13\.8kV airport substation and MV network modernization project.
* Manage project scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and stakeholder coordination.
* Review and approve project execution plans, design execution plans, procurement plans, and construction methodologies.
* Monitor project milestones, progress reporting, risk management, and contract compliance.
* Interface with Airport Operations, Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity, HSSE, SEC, Matarat, and external stakeholders.
* Chair weekly and monthly project review meetings.
