TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Lead the development of AI\-enabled products across credit decisioning, fraud and risk monitoring, dynamic limit management, and inventory and cashflow intelligence.
* Translate complex, real\-world data into decision tools that improve accuracy, reduce loss rates, and responsibly expand access to finance.
* Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and operate a modern data and ML platform covering ingestion, feature pipelines, training, serving, experimentation, and monitoring.
* Define AI work streams, milestones, and measurable outcomes; including approval lift, loss reduction, time\-to\-decision, and merchant growth impact.
* Establish technical standards across code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation.
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions across infrastructure, data providers, scoring components, KYC tooling, and payment rails.
* Hire, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh.
* Build strong security and privacy foundations that can withstand audits and support future licensing requirements.
* Partner closely with Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Partnerships teams.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.
* You bring strong software engineering fundamentals alongside hands\-on experience in machine learning and data platforms.
* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Head of Security Operations is responsible for ensuring the organization’s information assets remain secure, resilient, and available. In this dual capacity, the role not only leads the operational defense of the enterprise—managing the Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management—but also supports the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in shaping and executing the broader cybersecurity strategy.
   

  

 The role requires a balance of technical expertise and leadership, driving continuous improvement in monitoring, detection, and response capabilities while also contributing to policy development, security awareness, and long\-term resilience planning.
   

  

 The Head of Security Operations will establish robust processes, optimize security tools, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
   

  

 This position provides strategic oversight across Security Operations acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and a bridge between technical teams and executive stakeholders. It ensures that security operations are tightly aligned with enterprise risk objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. By coordinating with other security, IT, and business teams, this role ensures that security operations are efficient, proactive, and strategically aligned.
   

  

 Ultimately, the Head of Security Operations acts as both the guardian of the organization’s digital environment and a key leader in advancing enterprise\-wide cybersecurity maturity, ensuring threats are identified and mitigated quickly while evolving controls to meet emerging challenges.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership
   

  

* Oversee day\-to\-day security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
* Ensure timely triage, investigation, and resolution of security incidents.
* Maintain and optimize security monitoring tools, SIEM, and endpoint protection platforms.
* Develop and enforce operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and SLAs for incident handling.


 Strategic Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and execute the Security Operations strategy aligned with organizational risk appetite and business objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, threat intelligence integration, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to design secure solutions for new business initiatives.
* Lead maturity assessments and roadmap development for SOC capabilities.


 Business Alignment
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to business units, ensuring security controls support operational efficiency and customer trust.
* Translate technical risks into business impact for executive reporting.
* Collaborating with IT, legal, and business units to align security with organizational objectives.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership
* Ability to define and execute a long\-term security operations vision to combat existing and future threats.
* Risk Management
* Expertise in identifying, assessing, and mitigating cyber risks.
* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, QCB and NCSA)
* Technical Acumen
* Deep knowledge of security operations cybersecurity technologies
* Familiarity with emerging threats and security innovations.
* Incident Response \& Crisis Management
* Capability to lead during security breaches and ransomware attacks.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Ability to translate technical risks into business language for executives and regulators.
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
* Governance \& Compliance
* Experience in implementing security policies, audits, and regulatory reporting.
* Liaison with regulators and external auditors.
* People Leadership
* Build and lead high\-performing security teams.
* Drive a culture of security awareness across the organization.
* Analytical \& Decision\-Making Skills
* Data\-driven approach to security investments and risk prioritization.
* Ability to make quick, informed decisions under pressure.


**Qualifications \& Expereince**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree (Master’s or MBA) preferred.
* 15\+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles driving enterprise\-wide security initiatives.
* Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent industry\-recognized credentials.
* Extensive experience managing SOC operations and large\-scale incident response, including crisis management and executive\-level communications.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing enterprise security strategies, aligning technical controls with business risk and regulatory requirements (PCI DSS, ISO27001, NIST, GDPR).
* Expertise in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) frameworks, including policy development, audit readiness, and regulatory engagement.
* Strong background in cloud security (Azure, AWS, GCP), identity management, and data protection, with hands\-on experience in Microsoft security tools (Purview, Entra ID, Defender).
* Leadership in building and mentoring high\-performing security teams, fostering collaboration across IT, risk, and business units.
* Experience in vendor and third\-party risk management, ensuring secure supply chain practices and resilience.
* Skilled in workflow automation and orchestration (e.g., SOAR) to optimize detection, response, and compliance processes.
* Adept at executive and board\-level communication, translating complex technical risks into clear business impacts and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated success in driving digital transformation securely, balancing innovation with robust risk management and regulatory oversight.

* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits that ensure our employees are rewarded for their dedication and performance

If you thrive in fast\-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand \- this is the team for you.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a Head of Account Management to join our Kuwait team. In this role, you’ll be leading Deliveroo’s Account Management team, tasked with managing Kuwait’s best restaurants and chains, and developing the partnerships we have with restaurant partners. You will be joining one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups globally, surrounded by a top\-notch team of enthusiastic self\-starters who are passionate about delivering a fantastic service and contributing to the exciting journey that Deliveroo is on.
   

  

 This role requires an aggressive sales individual who can build solid relationships with all types of personalities in the F\&B industry. It will also require the person to be able to lead, develop, mentor, and coach a large team of managers and associates. Ultimately, this person is responsible for maintaining and expanding our market leadership and solidifying our restaurant relationships.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Lead our Account Management strategy in Kuwait
* Facilitate and lead meetings with high\-profile F\&B groups for new business, renegotiations, or relationship management;
* Own relationships with key restaurant industry stakeholders, with a focus on building relationships and increasing profitability
* Build up Deliveroo’s image and reputation as an established and valued leader in the Kuwaiti F\&B industry
* Managing a large portfolio of restaurants, driving restaurant performance through data analysis and industry knowledge to maximise order volume and growth potential
* Coordinate with cross\-functional departments to engage support for activities aimed to drive business growth and ensure operational efficiency (Marketing, Operations, Customer Service, Corporate)
* Manage a team of talented account managers
* Motivate the team to meet aggressive targets
* Represent Deliveroo in F\&B industry events
* Adhere to internal processes to streamline administrative support
* Build up Deliveroo’s image and reputation as an established and valued leader in Kuwait’s F\&B industry.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* 5\+ years of work experience
* You’ll be a self\-starter, capable of driving yourself to your team's targets.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills
* Strong sales skills and track record of account management success
* History of exceeding revenue targets
* Recent experience leading a team
* Strong knowledge of the restaurant industry is a plus
* Experience in a high\-growth business environment or start\-up is a plus

**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To

 🌱

 Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
   

  

**🧠 Build a career, not just a role**

**🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture**
 Collaborative, values\-driven teams that support how you work best.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire

**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

Are you ready to turn AI strategy into measurable commercial outcomes that elevate how we reach and support patients across fast\-evolving markets? From a leadership seat in Dubai, you will connect senior regional priorities with cutting\-edge AI delivery to shape how our field, marketing, access and medical teams engage customers and make decisions at speed.
   

  

 In this role, you act as the embedded translator between regional business leaders and our AI organization, owning the lifecycle of high\-impact AI solutions—from idea to adoption to value realization. You will sit with regional leadership, partner closely with enterprise AI and technology teams, and lead the charge on AI programs that power next\-best engagement, dynamic insights and agentic platforms. How would you convert complex, cross\-market needs into scalable AI programs that deliver clear ROI and sustained business value?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Customer Engagement: Lead the transformation of Interational go\-to\-market model across personal and non\-personal channels — commercial operations, salesforce excellence in partnership with the therapy areas, and digital and omnichannel — to improve effectiveness, drive personalization, and lift the impact of customer engagement.
* Strategy and Portfolio Ownership: Own the regional portfolio of AI commercial programs; create and sequence a clear roadmap aligned to business, medical, access and R\&D priorities; develop business cases and value narratives; embed reuse principles to scale what works.
* Use Case Translation: Engage senior stakeholders to surface unmet needs and decision points; translate them into well\-scoped AI use cases with clear problem statements, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiering; align to strategic focus areas including AI30\.
* Delivery, Scale and Value Realization: Co\-lead solution delivery with enterprise AI teams; shape pilots, manage scaled deployments and local adoption; define and track KPIs and ROI; apply appropriate evidence frameworks; remediate or decommission where needed.
* Change Leadership and Ways of Working: Lead structured stakeholder engagement; embed AI into day\-to\-day operations, moving beyond one\-off pilots; identify process and role shifts and work with functional leaders to implement them; partner with learning teams to build AI literacy.
* Data, Governance and Compliance: Serve as regional point of contact to ensure AI\-ready data and compliance with enterprise standards and local regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI Act, SaMD); adhere to governance requirements including registry\-before\-scale, model/data cards, ongoing monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* Partnerships and Ecosystem: Co\-develop programs with Commercial AI and Global Business Services; establish clear remits and hand\-offs across enterprise teams; build a delivery culture grounded in shared purpose, psychological safety and accountability.
* Integration with Enterprise AI: Act as the primary interface to capability teams across customer and patient engagement, data science and analytics, and platform engineering, ensuring clarity on ownership, priorities and transitions from build to run.
* Market Sensing and Foresight: Scan internal and external trends; track market and innovation shifts to anticipate opportunities and risks; spot and shape new enterprise initiatives; define leading indicators to monitor progress and pivot decisively.
* Near\-term to Broader Impact: In the first 90 days, assess demand, set the roadmap and launch priority pilots; in 6–12 months, scale adoption across markets, demonstrate ROI and codify reuse; over time, institutionalize AI\-enabled ways of working that accelerate growth and improve patient outcomes.

* Operational effectiveness, highly organized process with follow through
* Strong initiative to understand our core business goals and establish processes or programs to set direction, generate alignment and push forward

* Resourceful, motivated, influential and proactive; able to prioritize in a fast\-growing organization
* Experience in strategic planning processes and tools and/or project management tools

You will play a crucial role in driving technological initiatives, coordinating with multiple teams to roll out new projects, resolve issues, and uphold infrastructure integrity.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will act as the vital link between business and operational stakeholders and the wider technology ecosystem, facilitating clear communication and strategic alignment. Managing the country\-specific technology budget forms a core responsibility, alongside enabling support for critical technology initiatives and risk management. This role requires proactive leadership in technology product implementations, ongoing system enhancements, and prompt resolution of problems and risks, thereby ensuring operational stability and compliance.
   

  

 You will work closely with vendors and external parties to maintain and upgrade local systems and infrastructure, organize and lead service review meetings with key technology stakeholders such as ITSC and PSS, and provide advisories on potential risks with formulated action plans to mitigate them. Leading service improvement initiatives that enhance system performance and stability is integral to the role.
   

  

 As the central point of contact during high severity incidents, you will ensure swift issue resolution, coordinating effectively with ITSC, PSS, and network teams. Comprehensive root cause analyses for such incidents will be executed with follow\-through on preventative measures to forestall recurrence. The role also includes reviewing and approving change requests from the business, ensuring each modification is conducted without compromising system stability. Active participation in PSCs, ICS forums, and risk management discussions will be expected to uphold compliance with technology policies and risk guidelines. Additionally, you will facilitate technology and system\-related audits, ensuring they are conducted smoothly and to a satisfactory standard.

**Strategy and Operations**

* Collaborate closely with application and infrastructure teams to proactively address issues related to instability or outdated technologies.
* Implement stringent controls over production changes to reduce incidents caused by change errors, enhancing change management governance.
* Ensure high availability, optimal performance, and airtight security of business\-critical applications within the production environment.
* Oversee comprehensive maintenance of in\-country data centres and all associated infrastructure elements including servers, network equipment, storage devices, gateways, and telephony systems.
* Coordinate with multiple internal teams on new technology rollouts, operational problem resolution, and continuous improvement projects.
* Represent technology interests and provide leadership presence in various forums, acting as the principal liaison between business operations and technical teams.
* Engage actively with teams such as TSM, PSS, TechOps, and ITSC for incident management and escalation to ensure prompt problem resolution.
* Drive root cause analysis efforts for all high severity incidents, ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
* Work to reduce recovery times for critical system incidents, enhancing overall operational resilience.
* Identify and pursue cloud transformation opportunities to modernize infrastructure and improve scalability and efficiency.
* Manage service level agreements with business and operational units to guarantee satisfactory service delivery.
* Respond to and resolve high severity incidents in partnership with cross\-functional teams, minimizing business impact.

 Your leadership will directly influence growth performance, strengthen strategic client relationships, and elevate WSP’s Mission Critical portfolio — establishing repeatable, high\-performance solutions across data centres and adjacent mission\-critical environments where uptime, resilience, speed\-to\-commissioning, and operational continuity are paramount.

**Responsibilities**
 Vision \& Strategy:
   

  

* Define and execute the regional strategy for mission\-critical data centres, aligning with WSP’s global vision and Middle East priorities.
* Own the Mission Critical sector architecture and sub\-sector strategies (with data centres as the primary focus), including value proposition, priority accounts, partner strategy, capability roadmap, and a repeatable go\-to\-market plan for each sub\-sector. Establish clear scorecards and governance to track pipeline, conversion, margin, delivery performance, and sector maturity.


 Cross\-Business Collaboration:
   

  

* Champion collaboration across Advisory, Engineering, Sustainability, and Digital practices to deliver integrated solutions that maximize value for clients.


 Market Expansion:
   

  

* Position WSP as the partner of choice for hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centre clients, while advancing regional and multi\-sector priorities across the Mission Critical portfolio.


 Client Engagement:
   

  

* Strengthen relationships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring exceptional satisfaction and trust in WSP’s delivery capabilities.


 Operational Excellence:
   

  

* Oversee the delivery of high\-quality consulting and engineering services, ensuring projects meet mission\-critical standards for resilience, efficiency, and sustainability across data centres specifically.


 P\&L Accountability:
   

  

* Drive financial performance by achieving key Profit \& Loss (P\&L) targets, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring sustainable growth.


 Business Development:
   

  

* Lead strategic initiatives to expand WSP’s footprint in the Middle East data centre market, securing new opportunities and partnerships.


 Quality, Safety \& Operations (QSO):
   

  

* Uphold WSP’s commitment to quality, safety, and operational excellence, setting the tone for industry\-leading standards in mission\-critical delivery.


 Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead, inspire, and manage a diverse team of technical and strategic consultants and subject matter experts. Foster a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture centered on growth, technical excellence, strategic advisory services and accountability across business lines and global regions.

* Experience working within Middle East regulatory frameworks (UAE/KSA at minimum).
* Proven track record in business development, client management, and P\&L ownership.
* Strong technical understanding of data centre design, construction, and operations.
* Experience leading senior technical experts, sector teams, or multi\-disciplinary delivery teams.


**Core Leadership Capabilities**
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience with P\&L or division\-level budget ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple large\-scale, complex projects simultaneously under aggressive timelines.
* Deep understanding of data center\-specific design considerations, including redundancy factors and industry regulatory frameworks.
* Evidence of building culture, driving accountability, and setting governance structures.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.


**Minimum Qualification, Experience And Competencies**
**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, or related field.
* MBA or Master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage.


**Minimum Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience across data, analytics, or enterprise information management
* Proven experience leading multiple data domains or portfolios, not just a single domain
* Demonstrated ability to manage senior specialists and influence cross‑functional stakeholders


**Skills**
* Portfolio‑level data domain and product management
* Enterprise data governance and operating models
* Cross‑domain KPI and semantic alignment
* Stakeholder management at senior business and technical levels
* Ability to translate strategy into coordinated execution across multiple owners

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Intelligent Automation and Tech Innovation Manager leads the strategic identification, design, and delivery of automation and innovation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, modernize IT infrastructure, strengthen security, and reduce costs across the organization. This managerial role oversees multiple concurrent projects, drives continuous process transformation using advanced technologies such as RPA, DPA, AI, and machine learning, and collaborates closely with business SMEs, process owners, system integrators, vendor partners, and the Intelligent Automation Center of Excellence (CoE). The manager champions innovation, ensures governance, and aligns automation initiatives with organizational goals.
 



**Essential Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the intelligent automation and technology innovation strategy aligned with organizational objectives and digital transformation goals.
* Lead the Intelligent Automation Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives to standardize automation frameworks, governance, and best practices.
* Drive continuous IT modernization by simplifying processes, enhancing security posture, and optimizing operational costs through automation.
* Identify, evaluate, and recommend emerging automation and AI technologies to maintain competitive advantage and maximize business value.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and cross\-functional collaboration to accelerate adoption of intelligent automation solutions.
* Manage vendor and system integrator relationships to ensure delivery excellence and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes to ensure compliance and leverage new opportunities in automation and AI.



**Functional Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end management of multiple automation and innovation projects, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines.
* Define project scopes, resource plans, milestones, and risk mitigation strategies in collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
* Lead cross\-functional teams including developers, business analysts, and process owners to translate business needs into scalable automation solutions.

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Health Technology Assessment (HTA) \& PRA Capabilities Lead is a strategic role within Lilly Saudi Arabia's Pricing, Reimbursement \& Access function. The position holds a dual mandate: providing the economic and HTA technical foundation that enables the PRA function to deliver on its access agenda and building enduring capability across the PRA and Key Account Management (KAM) functions.
   

  

 On the HTA side, the role works in close partnership with the PRA Leads and Market Access — who own access strategy, reimbursement strategy, and the affiliate value narrative — by developing the economic models, evidence packages, and HTA content that underpin payer submissions and conversations across SFDA and public sector and reimbursement institutions, and key institutions. On the capabilities side, the role designs and delivers structured learning programs that elevate PRA and KAM team performance, support world\-class payer engagement, and develop individual talent.
   

  

 This role is critical to accelerating early access for Lilly innovations, sustaining access for in\-line products, and equipping Lilly's PRA and KAM teams with the economic fluency required to engage Saudi health system decision\-makers as the Kingdom's HTA and value\-based reimbursement environment continues to mature in line with Vision 2030\.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Health Technology Assessment \& Economic Evidence
* Partner closely with the PRA Leads and Market Access to provide the economic tools, models, and HTA evidence required to execute the affiliate's payer and access strategy across Lilly's KSA portfolio.
* Develop, adapt, and validate health economic models — cost\-effectiveness, budget impact, and cost\-consequence analyses — tailored to the Saudi healthcare context, with robust local epidemiological, cost, and clinical assumptions.
* Produce the economic content and HTA components of payer submissions to SFDA, and public sector and reimbursement institutions, and other relevant payers — under the strategic direction of the PRA Leads, who own access and reimbursement outcomes.
* Support the PRA\-led affiliate value narrative by supplying the underlying economic evidence, total cost of care arguments, and quantitative substantiation that translate clinical outcomes into payer\-relevant language.
* Work side\-by\-side with the PRA Leads and cross\-functional teams (Medical, Market Access, Brand, Regulatory, Finance, Supply) to embed HTA thinking early in launch planning and lifecycle management, ensuring the economic foundation is in place when access conversations happen.
* Maintain a forward\-looking view of the Saudi HTA environment — monitoring SFDA economic submission requirements, CHI guidance, and emerging value\-based frameworks — and translate this intelligence into recommendations for the PRA Director, PRA Leads, and affiliate leadership.
* Provide the economic modeling and evidence to support PRA\-led early access initiatives, innovative pricing constructs (e.g., managed entry agreements, outcomes\-based and risk\-share arrangements), and access maintenance for in\-line brands facing competitive entry or policy change.
* Engage with payer health economists, scientific committees, and HTA reviewers on technical and methodological matters, supporting the PRA Leads in defending submissions and shaping standards over time.
* Champion the integration of real\-world evidence (RWE) and locally generated data into the affiliate's economic evidence base.
* PRA \& KAM Capability Building
* Design and deliver a comprehensive capability\-building program for the Saudi PRA function and the KAM team, covering HTA fundamentals, health economics, payer archetypes, value communication, account planning, and negotiation.
* Establish a structured curriculum spanning onboarding, intermediate, and advanced tracks — aligned to Lilly's global PRA competency framework and adapted to the KSA market context.
* Lead the rollout of payer engagement excellence programs — coaching teams on stakeholder mapping, evidence\-led conversations, and account planning for tier\-one Saudi institutions.
* Identify capability gaps through structured assessments and partner with Learning \& Development, Global PRA, and the Hub to source, customize, or build training content.
* Mentor PRA colleagues and KAMs in HTA\-relevant skills, including economic model interpretation, value story articulation, objection handling, and scientific committee engagement.
* Define and track capability KPIs (submission quality, payer engagement quality, individual development progression) and report progress to PRA and affiliate leadership.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, peer development, and knowledge sharing within the PRA and KAM communities.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Serve as the affiliate's subject\-matter expert on HTA and health economics, providing the technical economic insight that informs the PRA Director's, PRA Leads', and brand teams' access strategy and value evidence decisions.
* Represent Lilly in external HTA forums, payer working groups, scientific societies (e.g., ISPOR), and policy roundtables relevant to the Saudi access environment.
* Partner with Global and International HEOR \& RWE teams and Hub teams to ensure two\-way flow of evidence, methods, and market insights.
* Contribute to the affiliate's environmental shaping and policy influence agenda — particularly on HTA institutionalization, value\-based procurement, and reimbursement reform in KSA.
* Operate with full compliance to Lilly's Code of Conduct, internal policies, and applicable Saudi laws and regulations.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree required in Pharmacy, Medicine, Health Economics, Public Health, Life Sciences, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Master's degree or equivalent is preferred (MSc/MPH in Health Economics, Pharmacoeconomics, HEOR, Health Policy, or Public Health). PhD is a strong asset.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical Market Access, HEOR, or HTA, with direct exposure to Saudi payers.
* Demonstrated track record of leading the economic and HTA content of successful payer submissions and supporting complex payer dialogues.
* Hands\-on experience building and adapting economic models (cost\-effectiveness, budget impact, cost\-consequence) for emerging or established markets.
* Prior experience designing or delivering structured capability\-building or training programs is highly desirable.
* Exposure across multiple therapeutic areas (cardiometabolic, diabetes, obesity, oncology, immunology, or neuroscience) is preferred.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Deep technical expertise in health economics, economic modeling, and HTA methodology.
* Strong understanding of the Saudi healthcare ecosystem — public and private payer structures, regulatory pathways, and emerging health policy direction (Vision 2030, MOH transformation, CHI mandate).
* Outstanding written and verbal communication in English and Arabic, with the ability to translate complex economic content into compelling, payer\-facing narratives.
* Proven ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strategic mindset paired with strong execution discipline and analytical rigor.
* Coaching and facilitation skills; comfortable leading workshops, developing others, and giving structured feedback.
* Collaborative, cross\-functional operator with a learning orientation and high personal accountability.

* At least 5 years of people management experience, preferably in a matrixed, global organization.

* Demonstrated experience in driving service contract growth and managing complex business relationships.
* Strong financial acumen, including managing budgets and P\&L statements.
* Fluent in English and Arabic.
* Must be able to travel up to 40% of the time within the region.
* Ability to work in varied environments, including repair centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

* MBA or advanced degree in business, engineering, or management.

Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
   

  

**Job Description**
**3M Health Care is now Solventum**
**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**
**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**
**Position Overview**
 As a
 **Value Base and Clinical Strategy Advisor** 
 for the Health Information System Division at Solventum Riyadh, you will leverage your expertise to influence public health policy and drive clinical strategy. You will collaborate with senior clients and thought leaders globally, contributing to innovative solutions that improve healthcare outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend strategic advisory skills with hands\-on project management, making a significant impact on healthcare systems and policies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Advisory: Engage with senior clients, offering strategic guidance on government relations and clinical initiatives. Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ensuring that Solventum’s solutions are aligned with both regulatory frameworks and clinical needs.
* Project Management: Lead and support complex projects related to healthcare quality improvement, patient classification systems, and payment schemes. Facilitate workshops, conduct in\-depth analyses, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Policy Influence: Assist in the development and implementation of Solventum’s healthcare solutions and services, particularly in areas such as value\-based purchasing programs, population health, DRGs, and other proprietary tools aimed at enhancing healthcare quality and cost management.
* Communication and Collaboration: Develop and deliver high\-impact presentations that distil complex project outcomes into clear, compelling messages. Work collaboratively across teams and engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Innovation and Development: Drive innovation within the healthcare sector by developing and refining solutions that address current challenges. Play a pivotal role in shaping the future direction of healthcare policies and systems in the region.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with an excellent academic record is required; advanced degrees (e.g., MBA, PhD) in relevant fields preferred.
* Master’s degree in Health Economics, Public Health, or a related policy field is highly desirable.
* 5\-7 years of experience in the public or health sector, with a strong understanding of healthcare systems, clinical workflows, and revenue cycles.
* Comprehensive knowledge of healthcare IT industry trends and clinical outcome measures.
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem\-solving skills, with the ability to apply these in a strategic context.
* Proven ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English (Arabic proficiency is a plus).
* Experience with strategic planning and the ability to adjust current payment schemes based on large data analysis.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


**Preferred Skills**
* Strategic thinking with a deep understanding of healthcare policy and economics.
* Experience with large\-scale organizational change initiatives in the healthcare sector.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, international environment with diverse teams and stakeholders.


**Travel Requirements**
* This position may include up to 40% domestic and international travel.


**Work location:** 
**Hybrid,** 
**Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**
**Supporting Your Well\-being**
 Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
   

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
 (\*) We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, age, civil status, disability, family status, or membership of the travelling community.
   

  

 Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Define and own the product vision and roadmap, aligned with company objectives.
* Lead product discovery, prioritization, and delivery across core platform workflows.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Risk, Operations, Partnerships, and Legal to ship reliable, scalable solutions.
* Own product requirements, backlog management, release planning, and delivery quality.
* Lead integrations with external partners and service providers.
* Define and drive product and development operating rituals \- backlog, PRDs, metrics, release readiness, and post\-mortems.
* Establish product metrics and reporting to support data\-driven decisions.
* Design and iterate on incentive and engagement mechanisms to improve adoption, retention, and healthy usage, with appropriate controls.
* Hire, coach, and develop a small, high\-performing product team as the company grows.


**How Success Will Be Measured**
* A clear, credible roadmap executed reliably.
* Stable delivery across core workflows and partner integrations.
* Improved adoption, retention, and operational efficiency.
* Incentive mechanisms that drive usage while maintaining strong controls.
* Solid product processes, team collaboration, and reporting.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have 7\-10\+ years of product experience, including in senior leadership roles.
* You’ve built and scaled products in fintech, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or operationally complex environments.
* You have a strong understanding of transaction\-based systems, workflows, and platform integrations.
* You’ve designed gamification, loyalty, or incentive systems tied to measurable business outcomes \- not just engagement metrics.
* You can translate business needs into clear product requirements and outcomes without needing someone to hand you a structure.
* You’re comfortable in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments and know how to create momentum where there is little.
* You communicate effectively across engineering, operations, commercial teams, and external partners.
* Bonus: experience in B2B payments, lending, or working\-capital products; FMCG or supply\-chain businesses; emerging\-market product launches; or A/B testing and cohort analysis.


**THE ENVIRONMENT:** 
 What working here actually looks like.
   

  

**Direct Line to the Top:** 
 You’ll report directly to the Founder and CEO, with short feedback loops and real influence on company direction from day one.
   

  

**Complex, Real\-World Product Building:** 
 TradePay operates in the real economy \- FMCG supply chains, merchant credit, and supplier settlements. The problems are challenging, the impact is tangible, and the platform is yours to shape.
   

  

**Early Stage With Serious Ambition:** 
 We’re building with operational discipline and a long\-term view. You’ll set the product foundation that takes TradePay from where it is today to genuine scale.
   

  

**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Everything you need to hit the ground running, set up and ready before your first morning.
* Mentorship that matters: Individual career development from people who’ve actually built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The Mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The Team**
 This group operates as a startup within Careem with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an exceptional founding Backend Engineer to build the WorkOS platform. This is a role for a systems\-thinker who wants to work at the intersection of high\-scale distributed systems and AI orchestration. You will be responsible for building the "brain" of WorkOS, the engine that deploys and manages autonomous agents across the region’s most complex operational journeys at massive scale.
   

  

 As one of the first engineers in WorkOS, you will have a disproportionate impact on our technical foundation, culture, and the speed at which we move from 0 to 1\.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Architect and Build the WorkOS Engine: Design and build the scalable backend services and architectures required to orchestrate complex AI workflows and real\-time data streaming. Leverage novel technologies to build cutting\-edge capabilities.
* Set the Engineering Gold Standard: As a founding member, you will establish our backend best practices, from CI/CD and observability to security and system integrity, ensuring a high\-velocity but rigorous engineering culture.
* Solve for Distributed Complexity: Navigate the unique challenges of integrating AI agents into legacy enterprise stacks, ensuring low\-latency communication and robust data consistency.
* Database design: Build our data infrastructure, leveraging relational, schemaless, and vector stores to power the platform and create persistent brains for our Agents.
* Full\-Cycle Ownership: Own the lifecycle of the platform, from rapid prototyping of new agent capabilities to maintaining production\-grade systems at enterprise scale.
* Drive AI\-Accelerated Engineering: Constantly experiment with AI\-assisted development to move faster than traditional teams, while maintaining a bar for superb technical quality and craft.
* Lead Pioneer Deployments: While building the core platform, you will occasionally lead the charge on first\-of\-their\-kind implementations for strategic partners, ensuring our tech solves real\-world operational complexity.
* Operate with High Agency: In this lean, startup\-style environment, you will be responsible for outcomes over inputs, rolling your sleeves up to code and balancing investments in the long\-term technical roadmap with the need to ship value quickly.


**What You’ll Need**
* 8–12\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant tenure acting as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead for complex, high\-scale distributed systems.
* Mastery of Backend Systems: Deep expertise in languages like Python, Go, or Node.js, with a proven track record of architecting concurrency, microservices, and high\-throughput data pipelines.
* AI\-Native Infrastructure Depth: Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, etc.), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), and RAG architectures at a production\-grade level.
* Systems\-Level Visionary: The ability to design "platform\-first", thinking in terms of APIs, modularity, and extensibility so that the WorkOS core can support infinite customer use cases.
* Obsession with Performance: A specialist's focus on latency and system observability; you believe that AI interactions must feel "instant" and "bulletproof" to be valuable.
* Startup\-level Autonomy: Comfortable navigating a "0\-to\-1" environment where you define the technical roadmap and ship high\-quality code without a playbook.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, to foster the high\-intensity collaboration required for this incubation phase.
* Experience with enterprise software transformation or legacy system integration is a significant plus.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* Architecting the Engine: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on building the core orchestration layer and agentic frameworks that will serve as the "brain" of the region’s enterprises.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
